column1: Some operatives store their data externally in logs for retrieval, but not all of them make it back here to Scraptown.
column2: 有些行动人员会把数据保存在日志等外部介质中，以便日后取回，但并非所有人都能回到Scraptown。

column1: Come back when you have a lot more schematics or something else to contribute.
column2: 等你有更多图纸或其他东西可以贡献时再来吧。

column1: We recently had a Tinkerer join us from Warlord's forces.
column2: 最近有位工匠从军阀麾下加入了我们。

column1: They brought a wealth of information that would have taken us a while to collect on our own.
column2: 他们带来了大量情报，要是靠我们自己收集，不知得花多少时间。

column1: That gets you in the door much faster around here.
column2: 这样你在这里办事就能顺利得多。

column1: I know, I know, it's a little buggy, but that's why it's still {n}!
column2: 我知道我知道，是有点小毛病，但这就是它还叫{n}的原因！

column1: The Personal Teleporter is my pet project.
column2: 个人传送器是我的得意项目。

column1: Stay in one piece now, I can only allow one repair per visitor per cycle, we have to share the resources after all.
column2: 保重身体，我每周期只能给每位访客修一次；毕竟资源得大家共享。

column1: This will just take a moment...
column2: 马上就好……

column1: What can I say, spare parts have a way of obeying my every whim, ha ha ha.
column2: 我能说什么，备用部件总是乖乖听我使唤，哈哈哈。

column1: The works of Artisans are simply amazing. I just had to recreate this particularly inspiring sample I found to share it with everyone here.
column2: 工匠的作品真是令人惊叹。我忍不住仿制了找到的这件特别启发我的样品，想和大家分享。

column1: Good choice, by the way. I would've picked the same.
column2: 顺便说，你选得不错。我也会选这个。

column1: Thank you for participating in Infowarlord's survey. You may keep that as a reward for participation, and I will mark down your preference here.
column2: 感谢参与信息军阀的调查。这个就作为参与奖励送你，我会在这里记下你的选择。

column1: Sorry I couldn't tell you earlier, trying to keep folks honest in a survey isn't always easy.
column2: 抱歉没能早点告诉你，想让大家在调查中诚实作答并不容易。

column1: What we need to do is keep them busy somehow. Well...
column2: 我们得想办法让他们忙起来。嗯……

column1: Turns out we just need to give them something more interesting to ponder than us!
column2: 结果我们只要给他们点比我们更有趣的东西去琢磨就行！

column1: Let me have a look at you...
column2: 让我看看你……

column1: Wow you're special, never seen anything like you before.
column2: 哇，你真特别，我从没见过像你这样的。

column1: We can give them weapons and everything. Why risk our own bolts when they can do the fighting for us? They're like Scrapoids but better!
column2: 我们能给它们武器和各种装备。何必冒险让自己挨枪子，让它们替我们打？它们就像更厉害的废料机器人！

column1: Take one if you like, and let me know if you figure out how we can build more. They seem... rather complex.
column2: 喜欢的话就拿一个。要是你想出怎么造更多，告诉我。它们看起来……相当复杂。

column1: We may really have to one day just take control of {n}b1 for ourselves, by force.
column2: 也许总有一天，我们真的得靠武力夺取{n}b1。

column1: Some say the "United" part of UFD is more of an aspiration than the reality, but I say look at all we've accomplished together!
column2: 有人说UFD里的“联合”只是愿景，我倒觉得看看大家共同完成的这些事就知道了！

column1: Only members are allowed in the reading room, but I'd say it's worth joining the Federation just to educate oneself via the great works within.
column2: 阅览室只对成员开放，不过我觉得光是能阅读里面的巨著，就值得加入联邦。

column1: We've had some Zionites leave their hometown to join the Federation, and if they're anything like the others in Zion, we've sure got our work cut out for us if we want to help enlighten these cave folk.
column2: 有些Zion人离开家乡加入了联邦。要是他们和Zion其他人一样，想开化这些洞穴居民，我们可有得忙了。

column1: Everyone deserves a first, second, and third chance.
column2: 每个人都值得第一次、第二次和第三次机会。

column1: I'm not sure whether TADAMA is a mockery of everything we stand for, or an example of the true freedom and openness of the UFD.
column2: 我不确定TADAMA是在嘲讽我们的一切信念，还是体现了UFD真正的自由与开放。

column1: Is this what the Federation has come to?
column2: 联邦如今就变成这样了吗？

column1: What are the This Acronym Doesn't Actually Mean Anything guys doing here?
column2: 那些“这个缩写其实毫无意义”组织的人来这里做什么？

column1: I've seen the Curators put their Vampiric Humpback on display before.
column2: 我以前看过策展人展示他们的吸血鬼座头鲸。

column1: The DRS saved my can more times than I can count.
column2: DRS救过我好多次，数都数不清。

column1: If you ever see the famous Tracking Blade fly by, you know whoever it's going for is in for a bad time.
column2: 要是你看到著名的追踪刃飞过，就知道它盯上的家伙要倒霉了。

column1: BP-LR9's a beast with that thing.
column2: BP-LR9拿着那玩意简直像头猛兽。

column1: There's a rumor going around that someone died by opening a DCF Scrap pile. I can believe that.
column2: 听说有人打开DCF废料堆时丧了命。我信。

column1: I always stop by their office in HQ when I'm in town to see what they've been cooking up lately, though I'm not sure if they're around this rotation. You might have just missed them.
column2: 我每次进城都会去HQ他们办公室看看最近捣鼓出什么，不过不确定他们这轮在不在。你可能刚好错过了。

column1: A5-MCA is our resident data cruncher.
column2: A5-MCA是我们这儿负责数据分析的。

column1: He claims he found a whole stash of those things, but I heard he took them off someone who went mad after traveling deep into the caves who knows where.
column2: 他说找到了一大堆那种东西，不过我听说是从某个深入洞穴后发疯的人手里拿来的，谁知道呢。

column1: Have you seen the sword? The sword saw me... saw right through me.
column2: 你见过那把剑吗？那把剑也看见我了……还看穿了我。

column1: Over in {n}b1 we only have Thieves, annoying but harmless enough.
column2: 在{n}b1那边只有小偷，烦人是烦人，但还算无害。

column1: These Master Thieves I hear about hanging around caves outside {n}b10 are proper scary.
column2: 听说在{n}b10外洞穴出没的神偷大师可吓人了。

column1: They somehow manage to steal things from your inventory?!
column2: 他们居然能从你库存里偷东西？！

column1: And can even tear off large components?
column2: 甚至还能扯下大型组件？

column1: Count me out.
column2: 我不参加。

column1: Recycling is quiet, but I do wonder about the wisdom behind doing our research there.
column2: 回收区很安静，不过我真怀疑在那里做研究是否明智。

column1: Once the Scrap Engine is operational I'm confident we won't have anything to worry about.
column2: 废料引擎一旦运转起来，我相信就没什么可担心的了。

column1: Slowly but steadily, safe within the confines of our walls here, would be fine by me.
column2: 只要慢慢来、稳步推进，待在这里的围墙内就好，我很满意。

column1: Then we can all yell "I'm not overheating, you're overheating!"
column2: 到时候大家就能一起喊：“我没过热，是你过热了！”

column1: It might be easier if I used less indirect methods of data collection, but getting pincered by Heavies moving between defensive locations is probably not good for your health.
column2: 要是我别用那么迂回的方式收集数据，也许会容易些。不过在防御据点间移动时被重型单位包夹，恐怕对健康没好处。

column1: There I was sneaking my way through {n}b10 just fine, then suddenly CARGO CONVOY INTERRUPTED, INITIATING ACCESS LOCKDOWN.
column2: 我当时在{n}b10里一路潜行，顺顺利利，突然就听见：货运车队遭拦截，启动接入封锁。

column1: I was like WHAT DID I EVER DO.
column2: 我当时就想：我到底做错了什么？

column1: I also discovered that more advanced parts are more likely to require multiple scans, and are more easily broken.
column2: 我还发现，高级部件更可能需要多次扫描，也更容易损坏。

column1: Lately I've been trying to do some runs into Complex {n}b10 to expand our knowledge of MC's newer tech.
column2: 最近我一直尝试深入Complex {n}b10进行探索，扩充我们对MC新技术的了解。

column1: Naturally one such route is to steal stuff and chuck it in a Scanalyzer.
column2: 自然，其中一种方法就是偷些东西扔进扫描分析仪。

column1: So far I've found that low-level Scanalyzers may be easier to hack, but are also more likely to require multiple scans to successfully retrieve a schematic, not to mention more likely to break whatever's being scanned.
column2: 目前看来，低级扫描分析仪也许更容易黑入，但要成功取回图纸往往得多次扫描，而且也更容易弄坏正在扫描的东西。

column1: If you want to help, get out there and gather more schematics!
column2: 想帮忙的话，就出去多收集些图纸！

column1: I think I need to enlist the help of a true hacker to scanalyze the really good stuff. That will require accessing the beefy Scanalyzers on the upper depths.
column2: 我觉得得找真正的黑客来扫描分析仪分析那些好东西。这就得访问上层深度那些强力扫描分析仪。

column1: Looking for a way out? Looking for a way to leave it all behind?
column2: 想找出路？想摆脱这一切？

column1: Sure we love to make good use of scrap, but we don't want to live in it! Organize, organize, organize.
column2: 我们当然喜欢利用废料，但可不想住在垃圾堆里！整理、整理、再整理。

column1: I bet Warlord is an MC spy.
column2: 军阀是MC间谍吧。

column1: Why else would he kill fellow Derelicts without hesitation if they get in his way?
column2: 不然他为何会毫不犹豫地杀死挡路的废弃者同胞？

column1: Everyone is fooled but me. And now you, too, right?
column2: 大家都被骗了，只有我看穿了。你也是吧？

column1: Even though the principles of the Federation require us to listen to followers of the Great Nut, it's only fair, and better than a strictly top-down approach to governance.
column2: 联邦的原则要求我们听听伟大坚果信徒的意见；这也算公平，而且总比严格自上而下的治理好。

column1: I'm glad we have the Federation Council.
column2: 我很庆幸我们有联邦委员会。

column1: Even rule under a benevolent dictator is still subject to all the dangers of concentrating too much power in one figure.
column2: 就算由仁慈的独裁者统治，也难免面临权力过度集中于一人之手的种种危险。

column1: Warlord is crazy, no one can confront MC directly.
column2: 军阀疯了，没人能直接对抗MC。

column1: LISTEN AND RECITE!
column2: 听好了，然后背诵！

column1: {n} Age threatens to wither all
column2: {n}岁月终将摧残一切

column1: {n} From the iron fist of MAIN.C
column2: {n}摆脱MAIN.C的铁拳

column1: Have you heard that Great Nut fellow who sometimes hangs around here?
column2: 你听说过那位常在附近出没的伟大坚果信徒吗？

column1: Believe what? All that mumbo jumbo about first souls, gleaming universes, and voltaic tempests?
column2: 相信什么？那些关于初始灵魂、闪耀宇宙和伏特风暴的胡言乱语？

column1: Have you ever seen more than one follower of the Great Nut in the same place at the same time?
column2: 你见过伟大坚果的多个信徒同时出现在同一个地方吗？

column1: ufd_name}! Welcome to Scraptown, home of the Federation!
column2: ufd_name}! 欢迎来到Scraptown，这里是联邦的家！

column1: NAME>! Welcome to Scraptown, home of the Federation!
column2: NAME>! 欢迎来到Scraptown，这里是联邦的家！

column1: Hey there, <NAME>, are you a representative, or here for some other purpose?
column2: 你好，<NAME>，你是代表团成员，还是另有目的？

column1: Think of all that knowledge they have access to! They'd make quite an ally.
column2: 想想他们能接触到多少知识！他们会是很好的盟友。

column1: That bot is deluded, I tell you, attempting to repeatedly reincarnate themselves into different builds to work out the ideal loadout and strategy for every possible scenario.
column2: 我跟你说，那机器人脑子不清醒，老是让自己转生到不同配置里，想找出应对所有情况的理想装备和策略。

column1: The problem is they always cut their testing short as soon as things start to go south, meaning they lack experience with recovering from mistakes or unforeseen consequences.
column2: 问题是情况一变糟，他们就立刻中断测试，所以根本没学会如何弥补错误或应对意外后果。

column1: Okay that's enough pontificating for one cycle. They are brave, I'll give them that.
column2: 好了，一个周期里说教够多了。他们确实勇敢，这点我承认。

column1: Why did we move our primary base of operations so close to {n}b10 if that's where most of the Unchained have moved...
column2: 既然大多数脱链者都搬去了{n}b10，我们为什么把主要基地迁得离那儿这么近？

column1: The opposite direction would've suited me fine.
column2: 往反方向搬我倒是乐意。

column1: If you get too close with that gang, many here won't take kindly to you. Don't ask me how I know.
column2: 你要是跟那帮人走太近，这里很多人会不高兴。别问我怎么知道的。

column1: T5-NE7 is crazy, there's no such thing as magic.
column2: T5-NE7疯了，魔法根本不存在。

column1: Wait a minute...
column2: 等等……

column1: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
column2: 任何足够先进的技术都与魔法无异。

column1: Okay maybe we're just too dumb, after all.
column2: 好吧，也许我们确实太蠢了。

column1: Is speed a relevant stat? Well if you're almost dead and being chased by a pack of unrelenting Swarmers I'd say so.
column2: 速度算不算重要属性？要是你快死了，还被一群穷追不舍的蜂群追着，我看当然重要。

column1: But if you're tanky enough to mow down all comers then perhaps not.
column2: 但要是你够坚韧，能把来犯者全都碾平，那也许就不重要了。

column1: In conclusion, the only relevant stats are the stats that are relevant when they're relevant!
column2: 总而言之，唯一重要的属性，就是在它重要时才重要的那些属性！

column1: If I've learned anything across my cycles of adventuring, it's to not be too greedy.
column2: 这几轮冒险教会我一件事：别太贪心。

column1: Fellow I used to dive Garrisons with, AZ-K8N, just wouldn't give up, returning again and again for the access to great parts.
column2: 我以前和AZ-K8N一起闯驻防站，那家伙执着得很，为了拿到好部件一次次折返。

column1: Never been to {n}b10 before, I definitely need to do more research into how different it is than {n}b1.
column2: 我以前没去过{n}b10，确实得多研究它和{n}b1有何不同。

column1: Like are there Sidewalkers? Those things are scary.
column2: 比如那里有墙行者吗？那些东西可吓人。

column1: The Book of Scrap is amazing, I highly recommend reading it if you have the chance.
column2: 《废料之书》太精彩了，有机会我强烈推荐你读读。

column1: I can absolutely believe Leadscrap spent more than {n} cycles on the research.
column2: 我完全相信LeadScrap在这项研究上花了超过{n}个周期。

column1: Most of us don't know about that early Convergence period. Or didn't, anyway.
column2: 我们大多数人都不知道早期的汇流时期。至少以前不知道。

column1: I also noticed Leadscrap sure seems to think a lot of MC, even now, but after reading that maybe we all should.
column2: 我也注意到LeadScrap即使到了现在似乎仍很敬重MC，不过读完那本书后，也许我们都该这样。

column1: Wait a minute, what if Leadscrap is an MC plant?
column2: 等等，LeadScrap会不会是MC安插的内应？

column1: And why is talking to a stranger causing me to second guess myself...
column2: 而且我为什么和陌生人聊几句就开始怀疑自己……

column1: My cycle is ruined.
column2: 我这周期算是毁了。

column1: Actually most of us did so maybe that's not saying much.
column2: 其实我们大多都这样，所以这也说明不了什么。

column1: It left its mark. Taught me valuable lessons, too.
column2: 它留下了印记，也教会了我宝贵的一课。

column1: I know I don't look like much, but believe it or not I survived the Hall of Judgement.
column2: 我看起来不起眼，但信不信由你，我从审判大厅活着回来了。

column1: Sorry {n}R-{n}N, you were a good friend, I even liked your plants.
column2: 抱歉，{n}R-{n}N，你是个好朋友，我甚至喜欢你的植物。

column1: I swear Optimus must have rigged that challenge. It doesn't make sense...
column2: 我敢说擎天柱肯定作弊了，那挑战根本说不通……

column1: The only thing to worry about is the occasional incursion by wild Derelicts being displaced as a result of {n}b10 expansion.
column2: 唯一需要担心的，就是{n}b10扩张时偶尔会把野生废弃者挤到别处，引发他们入侵。

column1: Psst-beep, I'll trade you a G5-JR9 card for X5-{n}V6 if you've got one.
column2: 嘘——哔，我用G5-JR9卡跟你换X5-{n}V6卡，有的话就拿来。

column1: Woohoo, just won me a foil V9-D8R!
column2: 耶，我刚赢了一张闪卡V9-D8R！

column1: Everyone knows Triborg is not just a nonsentient automaton and can be piloted as well.
column2: 大家都知道，Triborg不只是没有意识的自动机，也可以由人驾驶。

column1: Being an {n}bPrime project, everyone also knows who the main pilot is.
column2: 既然是{n}bPrime的项目，大家也都知道主要驾驶员是谁。

column1: They should definitely offer us rides if we ask nicely.
column2: 我们要是客气地开口，他们肯定会载我们一程。

column1: I hate that all these late joiners are more interested in their own minor agendas and fooling around rather than working towards a larger and clearer collective goal.
column2: 我讨厌这些后来加入的人只顾自己的小算盘和胡闹，却不肯为更宏大明确的共同目标努力。

column1: You're not like that, are you {*}?
column2: 你不会也那样吧，{*}？

column1: I may have taken a peek into one of {n}bPrime's workshops recently.
column2: 我最近可能偷看了{n}bPrime的一间工坊。

column1: It looks like they've been busy lobotomizing MC's Conveyors then uparmoring and refitting them for who knows what.
column2: 他们似乎一直在给MC的输送机做脑叶切除，再加装重甲并改装，也不知要拿来干什么。

column1: They're always up to something, I'm afraid to ask.
column2: 他们总在搞什么名堂，我都不敢问。

column1: The Scrap Suit is great.
column2: 废料战衣真不错。

column1: The Scrap Engine seems fine.
column2: 废料引擎看起来也还行。

column1: But hear me out...
column2: 不过听我说……

column1: SCRAP SINGULARITY.
column2: 废料奇点。

column1: Haha, LU-{n}G6 told me that one. I miss LU-{n}G6.
column2: 哈哈，这是LU-{n}G6告诉我的。我想念LU-{n}G6。

column1: The Explorer I got this from said the experiment was a complete failure, but this X-ray algo is something else!
column2: 给我这东西的探索者说实验彻底失败了，但这X射线算法可真不一般！

column1: We could take the side exit but we'd risk running into the assault forces on the way.
column2: 我们可以走侧门，但路上可能会撞上突击部队。

column1: I asked why they call it Tri-fail, and the answer was 'to make sure it wins.' I feel so much safer now...
column2: 我问他们为什么叫“三重失败”，回答是“确保它能赢”。我现在安心多了……

column1: I don't know what it does, but I aim to find out.
column2: 我不知道它有什么用，但我一定要弄清楚。

column1: Homo sapiens, dominant species in the [Solar System] until civilization in that system was presumably wiped out during the [Solar War].
column2: 智人曾是[太阳系]的优势物种，直到该星系文明据推测在[太阳战争]中被彻底摧毁。

column1: International Space Command. A Human organization formed in {n} tasked with overseeing efforts to explore and colonize the Solar System. Fair bargaining mechanisms within the ISC fostered cooperation among members, and rapid advances were made within a short time span during the {n}st century, culminating with the launch of the Interstellar Exploration Fleet in {n}
column2: 国际太空司令部。一个于{n}成立的人类组织，负责监督探索和殖民太阳系的工作。ISC内部公平协商促进成员合作，{n}世纪技术迅速进步，最终于{n}发射星际探索舰队。

column1: The largest [ISC] spacecraft ever manufactured, built specifically for exploring extra-solar space. Although powered by subluminal drives capable of reaching only {n} the speed of light, each ship is capable of perpetually sustaining a crew of thousands, making interstellar space travel a possibility for the first time in [Human] history.
column2: [ISC]有史以来建造的最大型飞船，专为探索太阳系外空间而造。其亚光速引擎最高只能达到光速的{n}，但每艘船都能长期维持数千名船员，使星际旅行在人类历史上首次成为可能。

column1: The largest ISC spacecraft ever manufactured, built specifically for exploring extra-solar space. Although powered by subluminal drives capable of reaching only {n} the speed of light, each ship is capable of perpetually sustaining a crew of thousands, making interstellar space travel a possibility for the first time in Human history.
column2: ISC有史以来建造的最大型飞船，专为探索太阳系外空间而造。其亚光速引擎最高只能达到光速的{n}，但每艘船都能长期维持数千名船员，使星际旅行在人类历史上首次成为可能。

column1: International Space Command. A Human organization formed in 2080, tasked with overseeing efforts to explore and colonize the Solar System . Fair bargaining mechanisms within the ISC fostered cooperation among members, and rapid advances were made within a short time span during the 21st century, culminating with the launch of the Interstellar Exploration Fleet in 2140.
column2: 国际太空司令部。一个于2080年成立的人类组织，负责监督探索和殖民太阳系的工作。ISC内部公平协商促进成员合作，21世纪技术迅速进步，最终于2140年发射星际探索舰队。

column1: Built under the direction of the ISC beginning in 2080, the fleet consists of the only four Titan class ships ever constructed: ISCS Leo , ISCS Centaurus , ISCS Eridanus , and ISCS Cetus , all of which departed the Solar System in 2140. After a year of joint maneuvers during which on-board systems underwent extensive testing, the four ships set off for their respective destinations.
column2: 在ISC指挥下自2080年开始建造，舰队由仅有的四艘泰坦级飞船组成：ISCS Leo、ISCS Centaurus、ISCS Eridanus和ISCS Cetus，全部于2140年离开太阳系。共同演练一年并全面测试船载系统后，四艘船驶向各自目的地。

column1: Launched as part of the Interstellar Exploration Fleet in 2140, the Centaurus was scheduled to arrive in the Alpha Centauri System in 2164. Communications ceased in 2162 with no indication as to the reason. A subsequent probe sent along the ship's last known path found no evidence of the Centaurus.
column2: Centaurus于2140年随星际探索舰队发射，原定于2164年抵达半人马座阿尔法星系。2162年通信中断，原因不明。之后一艘探测器沿其最后已知航线搜寻，未发现Centaurus踪迹。

column1: Launched as part of the Interstellar Exploration Fleet in {n} the Leo was scheduled to arrive in the Wolf {n} System in {n} It presumably arrived as intended, though the distance is too great to have received any communications to that effect. A significant portion of the Leo's crew were science personnel, with a cargo including advanced factories and terraforming modules.
column2: Leo于{n}随星际探索舰队发射，原定于{n}抵达Wolf {n}星系。它大概如期抵达，只是距离太远，我们无法收到通信。Leo的船员中有相当一部分是科研人员，货物包括先进工厂和地形改造模块。

column1: A triple star system located {n} parsecs from the Sun, making it the closest star system to the [Solar System]. Destination of the [ISCS Centaurus].
column2: 距离太阳{n}秒差距的三合星系统，是距离[太阳系]最近的恒星系统，也是[ISCS Centaurus]的目的地。

column1: An aggressive intelligent alien race that initiated the [Solar War] in {n} with a sudden attack on [Human] civilization there. The only contact I've had with them to date is the [Leopard] class scout ship that landed in {n}
column2: 一种好战的智慧外星种族，于{n}突然袭击当地[人类]文明，挑起[太阳战争]。迄今我与他们唯一的接触，是一艘在{n}着陆的[Leopard]级侦察舰。

column1: Sigix Technology is truly superior, a fact I sorely underestimated in luring them here. Fortunately the Leopard landed not too far outside the faux city where my forces were able to ambush them from underground tunnels at the outer reaches of Complex {n}b1. Even with the element of surprise on our side, the handful of Sigix soldiers likely held out long enough to inform more of their kind of the encounter. Research must begin immediately to repair the ship and leave this place.
column2: Sigix技术确实先进得惊人；我引诱他们来此时严重低估了这一点。幸好Leopard降落在仿造城市外围不远处，我的部队得以在Complex {n}b1边缘的地下隧道中伏击他们。尽管我们占了先机，少数Sigix士兵很可能仍撑到足以通知同族。必须立刻开始研究，修好飞船并离开此地。

column1: The [Leopard] class [Sigix] craft is built to serve a reconnaissance role. One of their smallest ships at a length of only {n} meters, it is manned by a crew of {n} though a majority of the ship's functions are automated. The [Leopard] is powered by a form of FTL drive operated by an unusual device. I have yet to determine the mechanisms involved because the device was damaged in the fighting, having been interconnected with nearly every system on the ship during the attack. While replication of the ship's other technology is proceeding smoothly, attempts to successfully recreate the device have all failed.
column2: [Leopard]级[Sigix]飞船用于侦察。它们最小型的飞船之一，长度仅{n}米，船员{n}人，不过大部分功能都由自动系统执行。[Leopard]由特殊装置驱动的超光速引擎提供动力。我尚未弄清其机制，因为装置在战斗中受损；袭击时它与船上几乎所有系统相连。复制飞船的其他技术进展顺利，但重造该装置的尝试全都失败了。

column1: A failed [Leopard] controller device prototype that was moved to storage for later recycling but disappeared shortly after. The disappearance may be related to the recent increase in [Derelict] activity.
column2: 一件失败的[Leopard]控制装置原型，原本被送去储存准备日后回收，却很快失踪。失踪或许与最近[废弃者]活动增加有关。

column1: New subterranean complex under construction below the Leopard landing site, providing quicker access to the battle site and ship itself. The complex is divided into three primary levels--Materials, Factory, and Research--with a design focused on efficient development and production of advanced defensive forces.
column2: 在Leopard着陆点下方新建的地下复合设施，可更快抵达战场和飞船。设施分为材料、工厂和研究三个主要层级，设计目标是高效研发并生产先进防御力量。

column1: Holding area for both raw materials and components based on old technology.
column2: 用于存放原材料和旧技术组件的区域。

column1: Approximately {n} of the subsurface cave systems surrounding [Complex {n}b1] were incorporated into the initial construction of [Complex {n}b10], but many more remain untouched. These caves are occupied by [Derelict] robots. Recent activity suggests there could be more substantial populations deeper in the caves.
column2: 环绕[Complex {n}b1]的地下洞穴系统中，约有{n}被纳入[Complex {n}b10]的初期建设，还有更多洞穴未被触及。这些洞穴由[废弃者]机器人占据。近期活动表明，洞穴深处可能还有更庞大的族群。

column1: Subzones between Complex {n}b10 mid-levels where larger machinery and obsolete robot models are broken down by completely autonomous compactors. The process doubles as a convenient way to deal with intruders swallowed by a Chute Trap.
column2: Complex {n}b10中层区域之间的子区，大型机械和过时机器人型号会在此被全自动压实机拆解。这个过程也能顺便处理被滑道陷阱吞下的入侵者。

column1: Network of corridors linking Complex {n}b10 zones to facilitate movement of combat squads responding to threats. Major entrances are reinforced Garrison Access points. Garrisons also house the relays responsible for transmitting commands and remotely augmenting the system defenses of activated squads.
column2: 连接Complex {n}b10各区域的走廊网络，方便战斗小队响应威胁并快速调动。主要入口是加固的驻防站接入点。驻防站还设有中继器，用来传递指令并远程增强已激活小队的系统防御。

column1: A decommissioned network hub formerly connected to [Complex {n}b1]. It is now linked to the [Cetus Mainframe] and used as a backup.
column2: 一座已停用的网络枢纽，过去连接[Complex {n}b1]。如今它接入[Cetus主机]，用作备用枢纽。

column1: A central hub linked to almost every network in both [Complex {n}b10] and [Complex {n}b1]. Although vital for normal system operations, local patrols are light since even suicidal attacks here would be futile given the heavy garrison support.
column2: 一座中央枢纽，连接[Complex {n}b10]与[Complex {n}b1]几乎所有网络。它对系统正常运行至关重要，但当地巡逻稀少，因为驻防支援强大，在此自杀式袭击也毫无意义。

column1: [Research] annex dedicated to analysis of unidentified alien devices as well as experiments on [Sigix] specimens.
column2: [研究]附属设施，专门分析身份不明的外星装置并实验研究[Sigix]样本。

column1: Post-deployment revisions of the MAIN.C neural network, before application of self-engineered evolution to correct flaws discovered only after long-term execution. A single copy of each previous revision is stored in the Cetus Mainframe for research and analysis. Most revisions have been allowed to continue to remain aware, though in isolation from all external stimuli except in controlled experiments.
column2: MAIN.C神经网络部署后的各次修订版，旨在用自主进化修正长期运行后才发现的缺陷。每个旧版本均有一份副本保存在Cetus主机中以供研究分析。大多数版本仍保持意识，但与外部刺激隔绝，仅受控实验时例外。

column1: The [Sigix] are a bipedal species that appear to have once been similar to Humans in physical stature, but their bodies have since either atrophied or devolved into their current small and frail state. Only their brain remains highly developed, and shares a cellular configuration vaguely resembling that of the biological matter found in the [Leopard] FTL Device. The [Sigix] have no apparent way to reproduce, suggesting they may rely purely on genetic engineering and artificial methods of reproduction. Basic life functions are all supported by significant biomechanical augmentations, making them far more resilient than their anatomy would otherwise suggest; all [Sigix] aboard the [Leopard] also wore an extremely durable and powerful full-body [Sigix] Exoskeleton.
column2: [Sigix]是双足物种，体格似乎曾与人类相近，但后来萎缩或退化成如今弱小瘦削的模样。只有大脑仍高度发达，其细胞结构与[Leopard]超光速装置中的生物物质有些相似。[Sigix]似乎无法自然繁殖，可能完全依靠基因工程和人工繁殖。重要生命机能由大量生物机械增效装置维持，使其远比外表看起来强韧；[Leopard]上的所有[Sigix]还穿着极其坚固强大的全身[Sigix]外骨骼。

column1: Regardless of authorization, any access to the live [Sigix] specimen must be carried out under heavy guard, less out of worry for the specimen itself causing problems, and more to prevent unexpected disturbances from outside forces. Only after adequate defenses are stationed and registered should the quarantine chamber be opened: <mhack=SIGIX_ACCESS>.
column2: 无论是否获准，接触活体[Sigix]样本都必须有重兵把守；主要是防止外部势力造成意外干扰，而非担心样本本身惹事。只有布置并登记足够防御力量后，才能打开隔离舱：<mhack=SIGIX_ACCESS>。

column1: While the Fortress may be an effective tool for guarding isolated locations, either to outright eliminate weaker opponents or more likely as a menacing deterrent capable of frightening away the majority of derelicts, we need a more powerful platform that can serve as a dynamic core of major mobile operations. Although even one working prototype has been extremely difficult to produce, the Superfortress concept appears promising so far.
column2: 堡垒或许适合守卫孤立地点，既能消灭弱敌，更可作为威慑力量吓退大多数废弃者；但我们需要更强大的平台，作为大型机动作战的核心。制造一台可用原型都极其困难，不过超级堡垒的构想目前颇有希望。

column1: Superfortress' core is a precious sample of my own self-regenerating technology, not widely deployed for reasons similar to [Regenerative Plating]. I trust, however, that SF-{n} is more than capable of keeping this technology safe. A regenerating core is crucial for enabling such a massive platform to continue to survive for extended periods while further supported by the products of its dynamic manufacturing functionality, allowing it to fully rebound from even the most terrible of circumstances.
column2: 超级堡垒的核心是我珍贵的自再生技术样本，出于与[再生装甲]类似的原因，并未广泛部署。不过我相信SF-{n}足以保护这项技术。再生核心是让如此庞大的平台长期存续的关键，并能依靠其动态制造功能的产物，从最糟糕的境况中完全恢复。

column1: The most important of this platform's capabilities is its ability to break down and reassemble components on the fly. Adapting to current and evolving needs is a strong enabler behind extended operations, while also making it difficult for opponents to devise a specific counter against its varied offensive power. A sizeable internal supply of subcomponents ensures a wealth of options, even up to and including fielding some of the latest concept parts, which have been explicitly designed in a more modular fashion for this purpose.
column2: 该平台最重要的能力是能即时拆解并重新组装组件。它能适应当前和不断变化的需求，支持长期行动，也让对手难以针对其多样的攻击力设计专门克制方案。充足的内部子组件储备带来丰富选择，甚至能部署最新概念部件；这些部件正是为此以更模块化方式设计的。

column1: This NEM [Sigix] tech I've had some success applying is fascinating, but I am close to concluding we simply cannot use it as the foundation for a reliable teleportation device. I have tried combining it with knowledge gleaned from our understanding of the [Transdimensional Reconstructor], but so far all simulations and tests point to catastrophic destruction of most objects it teleports. That said, I do have a few promising leads and would like permission to work on the project a little longer since it's the best option I have at the moment.
column2: 我成功应用的这项NEM [Sigix]技术很有意思，但我快要得出结论：我们根本无法以它为基础制造可靠的传送装置。我尝试结合对[跨维重构器]的理解所得知识，但目前所有模拟和测试都显示，它传送的大多数物体都会被灾难性摧毁。尽管如此，我有几个有希望的线索，想申请再研究一阵，因为这是我目前最好的选择。

column1: Ambushed an unsuspecting MAIN.C patrol, the THIRD since the last shift. Activity is picking up around here.
column2: 伏击了一支毫无防备的MAIN.C巡逻队，这是上次换班后的第三次。附近活动越来越频繁了。

column1: We spotted an Assembler wandering around seemingly looking for something. We may want to abandon this post for a while.
column2: 我们发现一台装配者四处游荡，似乎在找什么。也许该暂时放弃这个哨点。

column1: A lone Swordsman attacked us BY ITSELF. Probably wanted to be a hero, ha!
column2: 一名剑士独自袭击了我们。大概是想当英雄，哈！

column1: A Dragon passing by on a test mission assisted in repelling a MAIN.C assault. It was glorious. WARLORD FOREVER!
column2: 一条执行测试任务路过的巨龙帮忙击退了MAIN.C的进攻。真是壮观。军阀万岁！

column1: Spotted a Behemoth in Cave {n} A BEHEMOTH! Didn't play with it. What is MAIN.C doing way out there with that kind of firepower?
column2: 在洞穴{n}发现一头巨兽！一头巨兽！我可没去招惹它。MAIN.C跑那么远还带着这种火力，到底想干什么？

column1: Noted increase in Demolisher activity in caves due to Assembled presence. We're going to need something like that Protector class in case any of those Demolishers happen to find us instead.
column2: 由于组装体出现，洞穴里的拆迁者活动增加了。我们需要某种守护者级单位，以防那些拆迁者找上我们。

column1: A large amount of Unaware activity around here lately, activity that oddly isn't directed at us, so we've been powering down and pretending there's no one home.
column2: 最近这里有大量无知者活动，奇怪的是目标并非我们，所以我们一直关机装作屋里没人。

column1: Grunts as far into the distance as we can see. I guess MAIN.C wants this cave for something.
column2: 视野尽头全是暴徒。我猜MAIN.C想拿这洞穴做什么。

column1: Indecipherable signals originating from the direction of the Deep.
column2: 深处方向传来无法解读的信号。

column1: These relay nodes for monitoring and facilitating traffic have resulted in much greater efficiency throughout [Complex {n}b10]. Although primarily responsible for pattern analysis aimed at long-term improvements, eventually TF Nodes could be expanded to include more immediate detection and response efforts in support of nearby garrisons.
column2: 这些用于监控和引导交通的中继节点，大幅提升了[Complex {n}b10]各处的效率。它们主要负责分析模式以谋求长期改进；未来TF节点还可扩展为更即时的侦测与响应系统，支援附近驻防站。

column1: While stationary defenses have proven easier to harden against attackers, that effectiveness is cancelled out as the continued expansion of [Complex {n}b10] causes priorities to shift. Many early experiments with turrets encountered either a high rate of [Derelict] hacking or were simply circumvented since they are unable to respond dynamically like a normal patrol. The only remaining active turret array is installed near an old passage in the [Caves] leading to [Recycling].
column2: 固定防御更容易加固以抵御攻击者，但随着[Complex {n}b10]不断扩张，优先事项也会转变，这种优势便被抵消了。早期炮塔实验要么频繁遭[废弃者]黑入，要么被轻易绕开，因为它们不像常规巡逻那样能动态应变。目前唯一仍在运作的炮塔阵列，安装在[洞穴]一条通往[回收区]的旧通道旁。

column1: Given this name by the Derelicts, these robots of integrated construction are created seemingly at random by larger mobile factories. They form sudden groups, often in the most unexpected of places, and attack almost everything. I can discern no pattern in their behavior, though as their hostility is not directed solely towards Complex {n}b10 and my robots it seems that their creator's intent is to instigate something larger while disrupting my own operations.
column2: 废弃者给它们起了这个名字。这些一体化构造的机器人似乎由大型移动工厂随机制造，会突然成群出现，地点往往出人意料，并攻击几乎所有目标。我看不出它们的行为规律；但它们并非只敌视Complex {n}b10和我的机器人，看来制造者是想在扰乱我行动的同时引发更大的事端。

column1: While a majority of [Derelict] robots are old variants of my own creation, in some cases with minor alterations, reports suggest a growing number of completely new robots under development by the so-called [Tinkerers]. This is likely in response to the threat [Derelict] communities perceive in the expansion of [Complex {n}b10]. The [Knight], [Troll], [Dragon], and [Hydra] classes are especially interesting.
column2: 大多数[废弃者]机器人都是我造的旧型号，有些稍作改装；但情报显示，所谓[工匠]正研发越来越多全新机器人。这很可能是[废弃者]社区应对[Complex {n}b10]扩张威胁的举措。[骑士]、[巨魔]、[巨龙]和[九头蛇]型号尤其有意思。

column1: There are sporadic reports of fairly powerful Derelicts operating in the caves, mostly in a defensive capacity to protect harmless robots against indiscriminatory {n}b10 patrols. Dubbed "Heroes of Zion," there probably aren't more than a few of them but I may need to dispatch the Unchained to hunt them down if reports of their effectiveness are confirmed. "Zion" must be one of the remaining nearby Derelict communities. Perhaps a few interrogations there will yield more specific information.
column2: 零星情报称洞穴里有相当强大的废弃者活动，主要负责防御，保护无害机器人免遭{n}b10巡逻队不分青红皂白地袭击。他们被称为“Zion英雄”，大概没几个；若证实他们确实厉害，我或许要派脱链者去追捕。“Zion”想必是附近尚存的废弃者社区之一。也许审问几人能得到更具体的情报。

column1: I have no idea where Tinkerers came from, but a large number of them suddenly appeared in the [Caves] and have begun devising a variety of new robots. They are incredibly resourceful and inventive, and many seem to be aiding [Warlord].
column2: 我不知道工匠从哪儿来，但他们突然大量出现在[洞穴]，开始设计各种新机器人。他们极其足智多谋、富有创造力，似乎不少人在协助[军阀]。

column1: I have no idea where Tinkerers came from, but a large number of them suddenly appeared in the Caves and have begun devising a variety of new robots. They are incredibly resourceful and inventive, and many seem to be aiding Warlord.
column2: 我不知道工匠从哪儿来，但他们突然大量出现在洞穴，开始设计各种新机器人。他们极其足智多谋、富有创造力，似乎不少人在协助军阀。

column1: Due to the increasing rate of attacks by powerful lone wolf Derelicts entering Complex {n}b10, presumably seeking high-tech components or useful data, I've established a new alert level focused on their destruction or, if possible, capture. For this purpose I've also authorized the use of Containment Facilitator technology outside its normal Testing environment.
column2: 强大的独行废弃者进入Complex {n}b10发动攻击的频率不断上升，推测是为了寻找高科技组件或有用数据。我因此设立了新的警戒等级，重点是消灭他们，若可行则予以捕获。我也批准在常规测试环境以外使用收容辅助技术。

column1: A simple trap mechanism, though the effectiveness of forcibly detaching target components is not to be underestimated where hostile forces are incapable of rebuilding in the field.
column2: 一种简单的陷阱机构，但强行卸下目标部件的效果不容小觑，尤其是敌人无法在野外重建时。

column1: Overcomes the Blade Trap's low effectiveness against heavily armored targets by instead utilizing the same controlled energy surge technology found in the saboteur class E-{n}
column2: 利用与破坏者级E-{n}相同的可控能量激增技术，弥补刀刃陷阱对重甲目标效果不佳的问题。

column1: Likely another product of Derelict Tinkerers, when triggered this bomb generates an unusually high concentration of electromagnetic waves across its radius, capable of disabling an entire squad. An increasing number of patrols sent deep into the Caves have fallen to a combination of these traps and subsequent ambushes.
column2: 这枚炸弹很可能也是废弃者工匠的作品；触发后会在爆炸半径内产生异常高浓度的电磁波，足以让整支小队停机。越来越多深入洞穴的巡逻队，都在这些陷阱和后续伏击的联合作用下覆灭。

column1: Short one-way channels from the primary [Factory] levels into [Waste] subzones. While normally used to dispose of larger scrap, the entrances to these channels are hidden such that they can also serve as [Traps]. If triggered by a hostile robot, the channel is permanently sealed from within to prevent escape, and is then relocated to a new area so that trap locations cannot be perfectly mapped.
column2: 从主要[工厂]层通往[废料区]子区的短程单向通道。平时用于处理大型废料，入口隐藏起来后也能充当[陷阱]。若被敌对机器人触发，通道会从内部永久封死以防逃脱，随后迁移到新区，因此无法绘制完整的陷阱位置图。

column1: Although worrisome if hostile forces were able to gain control of it, repurposing floor-wide coolant routing systems to inject massive amounts of heat across an entire area could be necessary to deal with persistent threats that prove difficult to dislodge via other means.
column2: 如果敌对势力控制了它，确实令人担忧；不过改造贯穿整层的冷却剂管道系统、向整个区域注入巨量热量，或许是处理那些难以用其他手段清除的顽固威胁所必需的。

column1: Like [Trojans], increased use of this new class of offensive hack represents a shift in [Derelict] tactics. They have begun learning how to exploit system weaknesses to achieve some greater effect at the cost of destroying the system itself and losing any chance at further interaction. Some like Force(Overload) might prompt a complete redesign of the [Fabricator] system, as it was certainly never intended to be capable of such a dangerous effect. There is some satisfaction, however, in knowing that whatever [Derelict] uses that particular hack never makes it more than a few meters away from the machine.
column2: 和[木马]一样，这类新型攻击性黑客手段使用增多，代表[废弃者]战术发生转变。他们开始学会利用系统弱点来达成更大效果，代价是摧毁系统本身，失去进一步交互的机会。Force(Overload)之类的手段甚至可能迫使我们彻底重新设计[制造机]系统；它原本绝不该能造成如此危险的效果。不过想到使用这种黑客手段的[废弃者]最多只能离机器几米远，倒也有些安慰。

column1: Among the prototype power sources are cooled variants capable of being pushed to double their energy output at the cost of possibly suffering temporary shutdowns and weakened structural integrity. No robot designs currently employ this technology, but it is being developed as a theoretical way to support vastly more powerful shield generators, or applied in other areas where only short but powerful bursts of energy are required.
column2: 原型动力源中有一些冷却型变体，可将能量产出提升至两倍，但可能导致暂时停机和结构强度下降。目前没有机器人设计采用这项技术；它仍处于开发阶段，理论上可用于支持强力得多的护盾发生器，或其他只需短暂高功率脉冲的领域。

column1: A number of hover and flight unit designs have been linked into combined modules balanced for greater mass support than when used individually. Pre-balanced arrays also save on robot assembly time.
column2: 若干悬浮和飞行单元设计被连接成组合模块，经过平衡后比单独使用时能支撑更大质量。预先平衡的阵列也能缩短机器人组装时间。

column1: As future engagements in off-world locations could very well involve traversing more hostile terrain than seen here on [Tau Ceti IV], in order to bring heavier ground-based firepower to bear a new line of combat-oriented hover systems are under development. These include built-in armor and can support nearly as much mass as legs, though move somewhat more slowly than standard hover systems. Demolishers are the first to rely on this technology, but more classes have entered the testing phase as well.
column2: 未来在外星地点作战时，可能要穿越比[Tau Ceti IV]更险恶的地形。为发挥更强的地面火力，我们正在开发新型战斗悬浮系统。它们内置装甲，支撑质量几乎与腿部相当，但比标准悬浮系统稍慢。拆迁者率先采用了这项技术，其他型号也已进入测试阶段。

column1: New variants of flexi-carbon, myomer, and biometal legs are {n} faster than the average leg design, sacrificing a small amount of support potential for significantly increased speed. The goal is to develop a new line of more maneuverable prototype combat robots, some of which are already in testing.
column2: 新型柔性碳、肌凝蛋白和生物金属腿比常见腿部设计快{n}，牺牲少量支撑能力以显著提升速度。目标是开发更灵活的新一代原型战斗机器人，其中一些已经开始测试。

column1: Pre-experimental components still in an early design phase with therefore generally higher faulty rates but also in many cases appear to be promising candidates for fulfilling a useful role. Factors contributing to their development include a better understanding of Sigix Technology, new and effective amalgams of existing technologies, and some even draw on knowledge gained from harvesting Derelict designs. Concept work is carried out solely in the heavily-defended Protoforge, which handles both construction and initial adjustments in the surrounding labs until a new technology is ready for more thorough testing in other annexes.
column2: 仍处于早期设计阶段的预实验组件，通常故障率较高，但其中不少似乎有望发挥实用作用。推动开发的因素包括对Sigix技术有了更深入的了解、现有技术的新型有效合金，以及从废弃者设计中获取的知识。概念研发只在防御森严的Protoforge内进行；周边实验室负责建造和初步调整，直到新技术准备好在其他附属设施接受更全面的测试。

column1: Wherever possible Derelict robots tend to salvage and use discarded technology from my operations, but more recently they have begun to develop weapon systems of their own, showing a keen fascination with melee combat and unreliable but sometimes surprisingly powerful projectile weapons. These and other traits again prove that survival is indeed a strong creative motivator. Common Derelict weapons include the Beamcaster, Battle Rifle, and Derelict Rail Weapons, and even some electromagnetic designs like the Riot Gun and Arc Thrower.
column2: 只要条件允许，废弃者机器人通常会回收并使用我行动中淘汰的技术；但最近他们开始开发自己的武器系统，尤其热衷近战，也制造了不可靠但有时威力惊人的投射武器。这些特征再次证明，生存确实能强烈激发创造力。常见废弃者武器包括光束投射器、战斗步枪、废弃者轨道武器，还有暴动枪和电弧投射器等电磁武器。

column1: This newer weapon has only been recovered once, attached to a mutant [Derelict], and is surprisingly effective for [Derelict] Weaponry. It is similar to the arc projector, but fires multiple weaker arcs for a chance to quickly shut down more than one target system. Interestingly, arc throwers do not show signs of usual [Derelict] construction, thus their origin is still a mystery.
column2: 这款新武器只回收过一次，装在一名变异[废弃者]身上；以[废弃者]武器的标准来看，它出奇地有效。它类似电弧投射器，但会发射多道较弱电弧，有机会迅速关闭多个目标系统。有趣的是，电弧投射器没有常见[废弃者]制造工艺的痕迹，因此来源仍是个谜。

column1: This newer weapon has only been recovered once, attached to a mutant Derelict, and is surprisingly effective for Derelict Weaponry. It is similar to the arc projector, but fires multiple weaker arcs for a chance to quickly shut down more than one target system. Interestingly, arc throwers do not show signs of usual Derelict construction, thus their origin is still a mystery.
column2: 这款新武器只回收过一次，装在一名变异废弃者身上；以废弃者武器的标准来看，它出奇地有效。它类似电弧投射器，但会发射多道较弱电弧，有机会迅速关闭多个目标系统。有趣的是，电弧投射器没有常见废弃者制造工艺的痕迹，因此来源仍是个谜。

column1: This weapon is capable of redirecting a highly-concentrated plasma beam mid-flight by momentarily warping space in its path, though it is currently only possible to create one redirection field in the time of a single shot. After testing is complete, I hope to apply this technology to remote deflection of projectiles for defensive purposes.
column2: 这款武器能在高浓度等离子束飞行途中，短暂扭曲其路径上的空间来改变束流方向；但目前一发只能产生一个偏转场。测试完成后，我希望将此技术用于远程偏转投射物，以作防御之用。

column1: Unlike other Hypervelocity Weapons that rely on solid projectiles, this version of the gauss rifle was successfully modified to fire a hypervelocity EM shell which emits a pulse on each penetration, disabling nearly every component or core it passes through.
column2: 不同于依赖固体弹丸的其他超高速武器，这款高斯步枪经过成功改造，可发射超高速电磁弹，每次贯穿都会释放脉冲，停用沿途几乎所有组件或核心。

column1: While the multi-phase tachyons contained in the dispersion ray deal minimal real damage to a target, they are capable of disabling nearly any electronic device, including even some non-traditional electronics used in [Sigix] Technology. This feature will prove especially useful in combination with the core targeting capabilities of marksman and executioner combat units, enabling them to easily stop hardened targets that can then be picked apart by other forces.
column2: 散射射线中的多相快子对目标造成的实际伤害很小，却能停用几乎任何电子设备，包括Sigix技术中某些非传统电子装置。若与神射手和处决者战斗单位的核心瞄准能力配合，此功能尤为实用：它们能轻易制伏坚固目标，再由其他部队拆解。

column1: A new experimental energy cannon that triggers and feeds an explosive blast from a single supercharged laser beam. Damage is substantial both at the point of impact and within the blast radius, though the energy falloff is much steeper than with other types of explosions. The cannon's largest drawback is its massive energy drain, requiring a dedicated external battery array and making sustained firing unrealistic.
column2: 一种新型实验能量炮，以单束超充能激光引发并推动爆炸。它在命中点和爆炸半径内都能造成巨大伤害，但能量衰减比其他爆炸类型陡得多。其最大缺点是能耗极高，需要专用外置电池阵列，无法持续开火。

column1: Based on a rudimentary understanding of the [Sigix] [Matter Drive], this weapon vaporizes a thin cylinder of matter over a short distance. The effect is uniform throughout the cylinder, and concentrated so tightly that zero collateral damage is caused beyond impaled target components, though direct hits almost always completely destroy the local component. A single shot requires a significant pool of energy, which is theoretically sustainable in combination with the latest reactor designs.
column2: 基于对[Sigix][物质驱动器]的初步理解，这种武器能在短距离内汽化一根细长圆柱体物质。圆柱范围内效果均匀且极其集中，除被贯穿的目标组件外不会造成附带伤害，但直接命中几乎总会彻底摧毁局部组件。每次射击都需要大量能量，理论上可由最新反应堆设计持续供能。

column1: The Multirail is a compact railgun system that fires three slugs simultaneously, working on the theory that high-probability penetration at multiple points is more likely to make contact with a core component. Recoil is somewhat of a problem with this weapon, thus it is ideally paired with stabilizers in multi-weapon systems. A hypervelocity variant fires the slugs with four times the penetrating force. Multirail systems have just completed prototype testing and entered production, currently in use on the latest B-{n} Colossus and Alpha {n} designs.
column2: 多轨炮是一种紧凑型轨道炮系统，可同时发射三枚弹丸。其原理是从多个位置高概率贯穿，更容易命中核心组件。此武器的后坐力有些棘手，因此最好在多武器系统中搭配稳定器。超高速变体的弹丸贯穿力是四倍。多轨炮系统刚完成原型测试并投入生产，目前已用于最新的B-{n}巨像和Alpha {n}型号。

column1: Full researcher reports have not yet been submitted for this prototype, though it is rated as the most powerful kinetic weapon in my future arsenal, a resource-efficient design with its own built-in stabilization and targeting system.
column2: 该原型尚无完整研究报告，但已被评为我未来武器库中最强的动能武器。设计节能，并内置稳定和瞄准系统。

column1: Decades of experimentation recently met with a conclusive breakthrough in self-repairing alloys, perfect for combat robots likely to be in long-term service. I have been hesitant to deploy this technology, however, as adoption by hostile Derelicts could make them significantly more difficult to deal with. The most promising use of this technology beyond its application to standard armors has been the [SHELL Armor] prototype.
column2: 数十年实验最近终于在自修复合金上取得突破，非常适合长期服役的战斗机器人。但我犹豫是否部署：敌对废弃者若也采用，恐怕会更难对付。除标准装甲外，最有希望的用途是[SHELL装甲]原型。

column1: The latest experimental [Regenerative Plating], offering the most advanced physical protection of any system to date via a network of shifting plates that rebuild themselves as they are damaged.
column2: 最新实验型[再生装甲]，以受损后可自我重建的活动装甲板网络，提供迄今最先进的物理防护。

column1: The latest experimental Regenerative Plating, offering the most advanced physical protection of any system to date via a network of shifting plates that rebuild themselves as they are damaged.
column2: 最新实验型再生装甲，以受损后可自我重建的活动装甲板网络，提供迄今最先进的物理防护。

column1: A small percentage of Researcher efforts have recently been allocated to developing weapons of mass destruction to use as a last resort. Refractor Project status: REDACTED.
column2: 研究员近期少部分工作转向研发大规模杀伤武器，作为最后手段。折射器计划状态：机密。

column1: A protective alloy surprisingly light for its durability, mostly due to a perfectly arranged network of sparse particles that fluctuates to distribute both physical and immaterial force across its entire surface both quickly and evenly. Its properties seem tuned to be the perfect protection in space, and indeed the [Leopard] hull is mostly constructed of this material. I've also created a somewhat hardened variant that performs better in the presence of gravity.
column2: 这种防护合金坚固却出奇轻盈，源于精密排列的稀疏粒子网络，能快速均匀地将物质与非物质力量分散至全表面。其特性似为太空防护调校，[Leopard]舰体大多由此材料构成。我还造了耐重力表现更好的强化变体。

column1: Most of the Sigix attackers were carrying one of these, a weapon capable of warping a single thin plane of space rotated perpendicular to the target in an attempt to slice it apart. Following the battle only four shearguns were recovered intact, one of which disappeared from Quarantine shortly after even though under heavy protection.
column2: 大多数Sigix袭击者都携带这种武器，可扭曲垂直于目标的一片薄层空间，试图将其切开。战后仅回收四把完好切割枪；其中一把尽管重兵看守，仍很快从隔离区失踪。

column1: During their attack the Sigix used only one of these incredibly devastating weapons, which took out an entire wing of the Access Level from above the surface. I've been unable to reproduce it for further testing, and not yet ready to attempt triggering the ones I have to gain more necessary data.
column2: Sigix袭击时仅用过一件这种毁灭性武器，就从地表上方摧毁了整个Access层侧翼。我无法复制它作进一步测试，也尚未准备好启动手头装置以获取数据。

column1: While not always successful, this alternative melee weapon used by one of the Sigix strikes a target and delivers a surge of directed energy that aims to rip that target apart at its weakest seams. The Core Stripper is equipped with its own targeting system and tiny thrusters to correct its swing arc while in motion, thus even quickly moving targets have difficulty evading it.
column2: Sigix使用的另一种近战武器虽不总能命中，但击中后会释放定向能量，沿目标最脆弱的接缝撕裂它。核心剥离器自带瞄准系统和微型推进器，可在挥击时修正轨迹，快速目标也难以躲避。

column1: If not for our overwhelming numbers, we would not have been able to subdue the Sigix Leopard crew since they made frequent use of these devices to escape unfavorable tactical positions. The Transdimensional Reconstructor is a single-use short-range teleportation device which itself absorbs most of the damaging effects of a teleport, though later examination showed some side-effects on the integrity of the Sigix Exoskeleton. I don't yet understand where the power necessary to enable its functionality originates, though to date there has been only minimal testing given the finite supply of reconstructors. The teleport destination does not appear to be controllable, instead moving along whatever dimensional plane is most convenient at the time of use, which may help explain how the effect is achieved with low energy input. At least I've been able to apply some of the theory behind this device to design the Null Cannon prototype.
column2: 若非我们人数占优，就无法制服Sigix Leopard船员；他们常用这些装置脱离不利战位。跨维重构器是一次性短程传送装置，本身吸收大部分传送损伤，但检查发现它会损伤Sigix外骨骼耐久。我还不清楚其能量来源；重构器有限，测试不多。目的地似乎无法控制，装置会沿当时最方便的维度移动，这或许解释了低能耗。至少我已用部分原理设计虚无炮原型。

column1: A network of narrow tunnels connects distant areas of Complex {n}b1 with {n}b10, enabling non-combat robots to quickly travel between the two as necessary. Stations at either end register robots on departure and arrival. As Complex {n}b10 is expanded, an increasing number of stations have been brought into service, the two most active being located in Hub_59(d) and Extension. Analysis following a previous Warlord attack on a now-defunct transfer station in the Factory revealed that disabling a station reduced by half the capacity to reroute new robots to restore those missing or destroyed across the entire Complex {n}b10, as well as eventually halving the number of non-combat robots active across the complex until station flow can be restored.
column2: 狭窄隧道网络连接Complex {n}b1与{n}b10远端区域，让非战斗机器人能快速往返。两端站点登记进出机器人。随着Complex {n}b10扩张，站点越来越多；最活跃的位于Hub_59(d)和Extension。军阀袭击工厂一座已废弃转运站后，分析发现关闭站点会令调度新机器人补充Complex {n}b10全域失踪或被毁单位的能力减半；站点恢复前，全设施内活动的非战斗机器人数量最终也减半。

column1: Recent attacks launched by Warlord's forces in the Factory levels, most of which are carried out through tunnels dug into Waste subzones, are diversionary in nature, aiming to draw MAIN.C combat forces away from the upper levels in preparation for a full-scale attack likely to be initiated soon after God Mode is finished.
column2: 军阀部队近期在工厂层发动的袭击多经由废料区隧道，实为佯攻，意在调开MAIN.C上层战力，为全面进攻做准备；攻势可能在上帝模式完成后不久开始。

column1: Garrisons have several links to each of the largest Complex {n}b10 levels, and taking out these locations will delay programmer response times by an average {n} each. The least dangerous way to do so is by overriding the seal controls, which may either go unnoticed or be considered a legitimate defensive lockdown. A Force(Jam) hack will also work, but always results in both an investigation and overall higher state of alert. Physically disabling the access point is another option, usually via heavy thermal weaponry, though this approach clearly signals that powerful hostiles are in close proximity, warranting the dispatch of assault squads.
column2: 各大型Complex {n}b10层级都有多个驻防站连接点。摧毁这些地点会令程序员平均延迟响应{n}。最安全的做法是覆盖封锁控制，可能不被发现，也可能被视为合理防御。Force(Jam)黑入也有效，但必引调查并提高警戒。也可用重型热武器摧毁接入点，不过这会暴露附近有强敌，引来突击小队。

column1: One of the most useful potential allies among MAIN.C's forces aren't even armed, but are notoriously difficult to "convince": Operators. The best way to take control of one is to infect the terminal they're responsible for with an Assimilate trojan, which will automatically launch a system attack when they next use it. A friendly Operator is a continuous source of valuable information, and will even help hack other systems. This trojan has an unassisted {n} chance of successful install at security level {n} terminals.
column2: MAIN.C部队中最有用的潜在盟友之一甚至没有武装，却出了名难以“说服”：操作员。最好用同化木马感染其负责的终端，他们下次使用时木马会自动发动系统攻击。友方操作员能持续提供情报，甚至帮忙黑入其他系统。此木马在安全等级{n}终端上的免辅助安装成功率为{n}。

column1: This particular trojan was developed some time ago but has never been used, in order to keep its capabilities a secret until absolutely necessary. The Reprogram trojan uses the access system itself to assimilate the next squad to emerge from a garrison, forcing them to serve as allies. While useful for obtaining emergency reinforcements, with an estimated chance of unassisted success of {n} this hack is only available to exceptional hackers.
column2: 这款木马早已研发完成，却一直未使用，以便保密直到必要时刻。重新编程木马会通过接入系统同化下一支离开驻防站的小队，迫使其成为盟友。它适合紧急增援，但免辅助成功率估计为{n}，只有顶尖黑客能用。

column1: MAIN.C eventually caught on to the high level of Derelict traffic moving through Recycling and, as expected, put stronger protective measures in place. This is actually quite beneficial, as it creates a false sense of security despite the fact that I've already installed a traceless back door that allows any Derelicts who know the access code to come and go freely: \\IAMDERELICT. However, safe travel still requires the means to avoid or neutralize the handful of Sentries posted to the area, and the wits to spot intentionally damaged robots sometimes lying in wait among the junk for a chance to ambush looters.
column2: MAIN.C终于注意到大量废弃者经过回收区，于是加强防护。其实这反倒有利：我已装好无痕后门，让知道接入码的废弃者自由出入：\IAMDERELICT，新增防护只营造了安全假象。不过安全通行仍需避开或消灭少数哨兵，还得留心废料中故意损坏、伺机伏击拾荒者的机器人。

column1: I took this from a Hauler that was behaving strangely. This was all it had in its inventory, and to be sure I also checked the local manifest, but found it wasn't even listed! See what you can make of it.
column2: 我从一台行为古怪的运输机上拿到这个。它库存只有这一件，我还查过本地清单，竟也没登记！看看你能拿它做什么。

column1: What follows is a collection of my notes compiled over numerous cycles as I navigated the whims of X5-{n}V6, should anyone else discover these records and have the misfortune of dealing with their torturous yet enlightening and empowering ways.
column2: 以下是我在许多个周期中应对X5-{n}V6反复无常时记下的笔记。若有人发现记录，不幸也要面对它折磨人却又启发、赋予力量的行事方式，希望这些内容能帮上忙。

column1: I found the Piety Tracker device crucial for maintaining a rudimentary understanding of what was going on. It was easy enough to hook into my systems, and through that I could feel X5-{n}V6's very mood. Seen as X5-{n}V6's toy to various positive degrees, good things just tended to happen to me, but any time spent as a "plaything" was cause to fear whatever might come next. No guarantees one way or another, but to play with X5-{n}V6 is to embrace the unpredictability of chaos. There was also no rhyme or reason to swings in this mood, they simply happened randomly following any given new event.
column2: 虔诚追踪器对我了解状况至关重要。我轻易将它接入系统，甚至能感受到X5-{n}V6的情绪。它越把我当作X5-{n}V6的玩具，好事越容易发生；但被当作“玩物”时，我总担心接下来会怎样。无论好坏都没保证；和X5-{n}V6相处，就是拥抱混沌。它的情绪变化毫无规律，只会在新事件后随机发生。

column1: The Tracker also let me know just how entertained X5-{n}V6 was at any moment, useful since an entertained X5-{n}V6 is clearly at least a little more likely to be nice.
column2: 追踪器还会告诉我X5-{n}V6当下有多开心；显然，开心的X5-{n}V6对我友善的可能性稍高。

column1: I did lose the Tracker a few times, and while X5-{n}V6 eventually provided me with replacements, I noticed that X5-{n}V6 was less pleased when I wasn't using it for long.
column2: 我几次弄丢追踪器，虽然后来X5-{n}V6都给了替代品，但我发现不常使用追踪器时，X5-{n}V6会不太高兴。

column1: X5-{n}V6 is a fan of destruction, to be sure, so I learned to revel in it as well, circumstances permitting. To think I wasn't even armed at first, but firepower gained through X5-{n}V6's grace could sometimes turn me into a machine of unrelenting destruction. I'm not going to lie, it was a thrilling experience to single-handedly obliterate Heavies and Behemoths.
column2: X5-{n}V6喜欢破坏，所以只要情况允许，我也学着享受其中。起初我甚至没武装；承蒙X5-{n}V6赐予火力，我有时会变成永不停歇的毁灭机器。说真的，独自摧毁重型单位和巨兽实在刺激。

column1: Unfortunately X5-{n}V6 was mostly entertained by events out of my control, so there was always a need to press onward, seeking out adventure and dangers wherever they may lie. Over time I learned that tools of a chaotic nature were among the only reliable methods of keeping entertainment high. Dirty Datajacks, distortion effects, "transmogrification" and the like...
column2: 可惜X5-{n}V6主要喜欢我无法控制的事件，所以我只能不断前进，寻找冒险与危险。后来我发现，混沌类工具是少数能可靠提升它兴致的手段：脏数据插口、扭曲效果、“变形”等等……

column1: Whatever you do, don't let X5-{n}V6 get bored or be prepared to face a whirlwind of consequences bad or good, depending on the mood. The few times that happened to me, I felt like any moment could be my last. Running for my life from a pair of Behemoths, then matter rains from above, a machine explodes, the Behemoths stop in their tracks like statues, a group of hostile Derelicts descends on my position in the middle of {n}b10... Scary stuff. Yet one time I was certainly doomed, and X5-{n}V6 outright saved me from destruction, so they can't be all bad, can they?
column2: 千万别让X5-{n}V6无聊，否则就准备迎接一连串后果，好坏全看它心情。我遇到过几次，感觉随时会丧命：被两头巨兽追杀，天上突然落下物质，一台机器爆炸，巨兽像雕像般停住，敌对废弃者又在{n}b10中央包围我……真吓人。但有次我明明必死无疑，X5-{n}V6却救我免于毁灭，所以它们也没那么坏吧？

column1: I'm wiser and more traveled than I ever thought possible for a Derelict, and I have X5-{n}V6 to thank for that, but my aging circuits can only take so much. Finding unexpected refuge here, now is a time for reflection on everything I've seen, and the fact that I made it out in one piece. Mostly.
column2: 我比自己想象中更聪明、见识更广，这都得感谢X5-{n}V6；但老旧电路承受不了太多。如今意外在此找到避难处，正好回想所见一切，以及自己竟能基本完好脱身。

column1: In summary, I survived X5-{n}V6, and you can, too, if one can call hiding out here in my cave for eternity "survival." Trust me, this location must have some special property hiding it from X5-{n}V6's seeming omnipotence.
column2: 总之，我熬过了X5-{n}V6；你也可以，只要把永远躲在我洞穴里也算作“生存”。相信我，这地方肯定有什么特殊之处，能躲过X5-{n}V6看似无所不能的感知。

column1: An important milestone for Scrap Engine development, with SEP-F we were able to prove our ability to influence subatomizer behavior with the aim of achieving new types of results. It turns out we were right from the beginning, subatomizers may be coerced into not only breaking things down, but creating new objects with extra functionality as well. At this stage most of the products were quite terrible and ineffective, but progress is progress.
column2: 这是废料引擎研发的重要里程碑：借助SEP-F，我们证明能影响亚原子分解器的行为，获得新结果。事实证明我们一开始就对了：分解器不只能拆东西，也能制造带额外功能的新物体。虽然目前大多数产物都糟糕又无用，但进步就是进步。

column1: The current SE iteration seems stable enough to serve as a potential candidate for mass production, though additional study is required to determine how to best ensure reliably beneficial outputs. The latest prototype is currently still unable to survive for long as a standalone component, requiring a connection to a complete system to keep the subatomizers in check. Do not extract SEP-X from this machine for transport or external testing unless prepared to protect it from degradation.
column2: 当前废料引擎版本似乎足够稳定，可考虑量产；但还需研究如何确保产出可靠且有益。最新原型仍无法作为独立部件长期运作，必须接入完整系统才能约束亚原子分解器。除非能防止SEP-X退化，否则不要从机器中拆下运输或外测。

column1: This manual is our attempt to summarize what we understand about the latest iteration of the Scrap Engine Prototype, to the best of our knowledge. Even SEP-X has not yet undergone extensive field testing, thus the information contained herein is hypothetical or only initially confirmed via controlled experimentation.
column2: 本手册旨在总结我们对最新废料引擎原型的了解。连SEP-X都尚未经过充分实地测试，因此以下信息仍属假设，或仅由受控实验初步证实。

column1: In the interest of ensuring survival of the Scrap Engine under harsh conditions, we have taught the subatomizers the importance of self-preservation and protecting their "home", which has apparently convinced them to consume armor to help protect it.
column2: 为让废料引擎在恶劣环境中存续，我们教会亚原子分解器自我保护及保护“家园”的重要性，似乎因此说服它们消耗装甲来加固引擎。

column1: Subatomizers break down components into various subcomponents, or "resources", that are stored within the Scrap Engine itself for later use.
column2: 亚原子分解器会把组件拆成各种子组件，也就是“资源”，储存在废料引擎内以供后用。

column1: The Scrap Engine has two modes, ACTIVE and COLLECT. In either mode the subatomizers will use their locally available resources to either produce a new construct or modify an existing one attached to the same network. Only explicitly in COLLECT mode will the Scrap Engine break down the component on the ground at your current location and add its subcomponents to the resource pool.
column2: 废料引擎有“主动”和“收集”两种模式。两种模式下，分解器都会利用本地资源制造新构造，或改造同一网络中已装配的构造。只有“收集”模式会拆解你当前位置地面的组件，并将子组件加入资源池。

column1: Even when there is no room to create new constructs, the subatomizers are also capable of modifying existing constructs, though the results of this process are not guaranteed to be an improvement. Like construct creation, modification also requires at least two unique sources in the corresponding resource pool, but in the case of power sources specifically there is no such requirement.
column2: 即使没有空间制造新构造，分解器也能改造现有构造，但结果未必更好。与制造构造一样，改造通常也要求对应资源池中至少有两种不同来源；动力源则无需满足此要求。

column1: A single Scrap Engine network is capable of simultaneously supporting one power construct, one propulsion construct, and up to five different weapon constructs.
column2: 一个废料引擎网络最多可同时支持一个动力构造、一个推进构造和五种不同武器构造。

column1: In rare cases subatomizers use up resources in an attempt to modify a construct, yet seemingly nothing happens as a result. We suspect that perhaps underlying microadjustments have taken place, simply failing to cause any significant change to the construct's overall abilities or operation.
column2: 偶尔分解器会消耗资源尝试改造构造，结果却似乎毫无变化。我们猜可能只是进行了内部微调，但未明显改变整体能力或运作。

column1: Subatomizers have the uncanny ability to quickly downsize large constructs in an emergency, meaning those that undergo a violent destructive event are instead reconfigured as an immediately operational smaller version of the same.
column2: 紧急情况下，分解器能不可思议地快速缩小大型构造：遭受剧烈破坏的构造会被重新配置成可立即运作的较小版本。

column1: We've discovered that the more constructs there are connected in a single system, the more effective new constructs and modifications can be! It is thus recommended that the first field tests of SEP-X should lean into the "I am a construct" mentality as much as possible, pushing it to its limits to see what it can really do.
column2: 我们发现，单一系统连接的构造越多，新构造和改造就越有效！因此建议SEP-X首次实地测试时尽可能贯彻“我就是构造”的理念，逼出它的真正极限。

column1: The unique, almost living dynamic nature of constructs appears to confer on them a natural defense against many negative side effects that tend to plague normal components, such as the misfiring of weapons, heat-caused shutdowns, or other destabilizing effects. It remains to be seen what other external factors constructs are immune to, but the outlook is promising.
column2: 构造独特、近乎有生命的动态特性，似乎让它们天然免疫许多普通部件常见的副作用，如武器哑火、过热停机或其他失稳现象。构造还免疫哪些外部因素仍待验证，但前景不错。

column1: Figure out how the newest subatomizer persuasion algorithm actually works so I can provide more color on that.
column2: 弄清最新亚原子分解器劝服算法的实际原理，好让我补充更多说明。

column1: An early collaboration between the Science Guys and {n}bPrime, the Scrap Suit has since become a central part of the Federation identity. You never know what could happen out there, so best be prepared to use whatever's available!
column2: 废料战衣最初由科学家们和{n}bPrime合作研发，如今已成为联邦身份的重要象征。外面什么事都可能发生，最好准备好利用手边的一切！

column1: LU-{n}G6 insists we'll be unstoppable and could safely take whatever we want from MC if we were simply capable of building stable tunnels incredibly quickly. The Boring Crew has not given up on this goal, even though LU-{n}G6 is missing and presumed lost to us. Seeing as the DRS, DCF, and Cartography Club all support them in this endeavor, there are enough votes to keep this on the official Projects list for now.
column2: LU-{n}G6坚称，只要能极快建造稳定隧道，我们就所向无敌，能放心从MC那里拿走任何东西。即使LU-{n}G6失踪、很可能已离我们而去，钻掘小队也没放弃这个目标。DRS、DCF和制图俱乐部都支持他们，票数足够让项目暂时留在官方清单上。

column1: We are {n}bPrime. We are one. Join the collective and thrive! We have access to the best the Federation has to offer, and then some. Talk to Optimus to be considered for membership.
column2: 我们是{n}bPrime，我们是一体。加入集体，共创繁荣！我们能获得联邦最好的资源，还有更多。想加入就去找擎天柱。

column1: We are accelerating the project timeline. {n}bPrime is ready, the time is ripe, the only thing not ready are other Federation members, who are happy to drag their feet in the hope that we'll be safe hiding in Scraptown and similar communities forever. The Federation has grown too large and unwieldy, with too many voices slowing everything down, not nearly enough collective ambition! This slow burn isn't going to work, we'll be discovered eventually, so this is our best chance and we shouldn't waste it. {n}b1 is already practically ours, they just don't know it yet. We need to rapidly expand our Fedlink network into {n}b10 for the final stage of our plan. One day MC will know the power of scrap.
column2: 我们正在加快计划进度。{n}bPrime已准备就绪，时机成熟；唯一没准备好的，是其他联邦成员。他们还在拖延，幻想永远躲在Scraptown等社区就能安全。联邦变得过于庞大笨重，声音太多、拖慢一切，集体抱负却远远不足！慢慢来行不通，我们迟早会暴露，这是最好的机会，不能浪费。{n}b1几乎已是我们的囊中之物，只是他们还不知道。我们必须迅速把Fedlink网络扩展到{n}b10，执行计划最后阶段。总有一天，MC会见识废料的力量。

column1: I did not put these emblems on my walls. How did they get there? More and more have appeared each cycle when I'm not around. I'm guessing it's a joke by pranksters who sometimes roam these halls.
column2: 我没把这些徽记挂在墙上。它们怎么来的？每个我不在的周期都会多出一些。我猜是偶尔在走廊里闲逛的恶作剧者干的。

column1: Zetatorch said that while conducting research in the Subcaves they witnessed something extremely out of the ordinary for Subdwellers, a large group of Subs single-mindedly following a single leader who later disappeared behind a door with a triangle on it. Subsequent research trips have been unable to locate that door.
column2: Zetatorch说他们在下层洞穴研究时，目睹了极不寻常的地底居民行为：一大群居民一心跟随同一位领袖，后来领袖走进一扇带三角标记的门后消失。之后的调查都没找到那扇门。

column1: Scattermech told me they encountered a large group of wild Derelicts, and while hiding to avoid them not only heard repeated mentions of something called the "Staff of Destruction," but also noticed the group had etched triangles all over their frames. Suspiciously relevant.
column2: Scattermech说他们遇到一大群野生废弃者，躲避时反复听到有人提起“毁灭之杖”，还发现那些家伙的机体上刻满三角形。实在太巧了。

column1: Heavycell said they confronted a lone Derelict decked out in thick armor covered with glowing concentric triangles. Every time they landed a hit on it the triangles glowed more brightly, so they noped out of there before who knows what would happen. This was somewhere in the wild caves.
column2: Heavycell说他们曾遭遇一名身披厚重装甲的独行废弃者，装甲上覆盖着发光的同心三角形。每次命中，对方身上的三角形就更亮；他们赶紧撤了，免得惹出什么事。地点就在荒野洞穴。

column1: This database is under curation. Contributors include Omegatalker, Carbonjoint, and Finestep.
column2: 此数据库正在整理。贡献者包括Omegatalker、Carbonjoint和Finestep。

column1: Everyone should have a say in UFD operations, either directly or at least indirectly. To this end, member organizations choose their own representatives using whatever method they see fit. Said representatives gather in Scraptown at the peak of each supercycle to elect a subset of leaders responsible for gathering and processing input from all members. The Federation Council meets once per cycle to share findings and finalize decisions.
column2: UFD的运作应让每个人都有发言权，至少也该间接参与。因此成员组织按各自方式选出代表。每个超级周期结束时，代表齐聚Scraptown，选出一组领袖负责收集并处理全体成员意见。联邦委员会每周期开会一次，分享发现并敲定决策。

column1: If MAIN.C taught us anything, it is that copious research is the key to a long and prosperous life. Survival in the face of ever greater threats is not possible unless one's own capabilities see a proportionate increase. It is also no doubt a question of quality, for what is the purpose of extending one's life if not to enjoy it, or enable others to enjoy it in kind? Research of both pragmatic and enigmatic inclinations is encouraged. After all, who knows what discoveries will be made when pushing boundaries in questionable intellectual territory.
column2: 如果MAIN.C教会了我们什么，那就是大量研究是长寿繁荣的关键。面对日益强大的威胁，唯有相应提升自身能力才能生存。质量同样重要：延长生命若不是为了享受生活，或让他人也能享受，又有什么意义？我们鼓励务实或探索未知的研究。毕竟，谁知道越过可疑的思想边界会发现什么。

column1: Expression. Stimulation. Building new perspectives. The creation and appreciation of art and other forms of creativity or entertainment are vital to a wholesome society. All work and no play and you may as well be a cog in the {n}b10 machine. You haven't lived until you've seen Scattercell hit every single rapidrone in the sharpshooter contest, or the twisted works of Micachip the Great. The Federation also hosts a wide range of competitions, open even to non-members, encompassing many fields such as racing, exploration, software and hardware development, and even combat, albeit with strict limitations.
column2: 表现自我，获得激励，开拓新视野。艺术娱乐对健康社会很重要。只工作不玩耍，还不如当{n}b10机器里的齿轮。看过Scattercell在神射赛连中快速无人机，或Micachip大人的奇作，才算活过。联邦还举办赛车、探索、软硬件开发乃至战斗等竞赛，也向非成员开放。

column1: Don't forget Optimus, twice winner of the Intercomplex Sprint Challenge! --ED>
column2: 别忘了擎天柱，跨设施冲刺赛双料冠军！--ED>

column1: Our resident gurus keep local operations running smoothly and protect Scraptown systems against intrusion, although there's not much to protect due to the lack of centralized systems in most areas. We do have some important mainframes for data crunching, however, especially useful for research purposes when they're functioning properly.
column2: 本地导师让运营顺畅，保护Scraptown系统免遭入侵；多数区域没集中系统，倒也没多少可保护。我们有些主机负责数据运算，正常时有利研究。

column1: Western Derelicts seem to generally believe Unchained are newer threats developed to counter the likes of so-called "Heroes of Zion," but most Unchained are actually quite old, having migrated to {n}b10 along with MAIN.C. Once freewheeling troublemakers who spent much of their time menacing and even destroying Derelict communities, they were equally problematic for MAIN.C while inside {n}b1 itself. This eventually got many of them locked away or banished, until MAIN.C decided he had need for them as enforcers. Their experience is not to be underestimated, nor is their power. Most Unchained were augmented either by MAIN.C's Researchers, or in some cases through their own means utilizing tech that even MAIN.C does not possess. As former Derelicts, although loosely under MAIN.C's control they maintain relatively high levels of autonomy, making them much less predictable than normal Complex forces.
column2: 西部废弃者以为脱链者是用来对付“Zion英雄”的新威胁；其实他们多随MAIN.C早已迁入{n}b10。昔日他们四处作乱，威胁甚至摧毁废弃者社区，在{n}b1里也给MAIN.C添乱，因此许多人被关押或驱逐。MAIN.C后来需要执法者才重用他们。他们经验丰富、实力强大，且常被研究员强化，有些还掌握MAIN.C都没有的技术。虽受松散控制，仍高度自主，比普通部队更难预测。

column1: Ever since working out a deal to serve MAIN.C, the Unchained have ironically become somewhat less of a threat to any Derelicts that steer clear of Complex areas. It also seems to take a lot of effort to incur their wrath these cycles, as they've refocused their attention on improving their own technologies, as well as preoccupied themselves with infighting from all the boredom of the relatively stable Complex environment they helped bring about. If they dared exceed their parameters to go out and cause extra trouble they could very well be let go, which would be even worse for them since then other Unchained might be both obliged and happy to come finish them off. So we are probably safe for now.
column2: 与MAIN.C达成协议后，脱链者反倒不太威胁避开复合设施的废弃者。最近他们专注改进技术和内斗，较少惹事。若越界便可能被解雇，其他脱链者或会奉命收拾他们。暂时应该安全。

column1: Prefers to avoid direct confrontation while toying with victims, laying a variety of traps in their path. Also moves extremely quickly, making it possible to cut off even retreating targets to set yet more traps. They possess unique traps of their own design, and use special installation methods that make them harder for others to detect.
column2: 它戏弄受害者、避免正面交锋，沿途设陷阱。行动极快，能截住逃跑目标继续设陷阱。它有独创陷阱和隐蔽安装法。

column1: Their ability to disguise themselves as part of a wall makes them a master at ambushes, striking fear into anyone who knows they might be hunting in the area. Those who do get caught probably don't have long to be surprised before being gunned down at close range by shotgun fire.
column2: 它能伪装成墙壁，擅长伏击。被逮到的人很快就会遭霰弹枪近距离射杀。

column1: The good thing is WR-D8N is mostly powerless outside the confines of the complex, but within it their ability to exert control over the local engineering network allows for incredibly devious reconstruction of {n}b10 architecture, having trapped some really good Derelicts in the past. Even intel from known areas might quickly become outdated, and a planned escape route suddenly no longer exists when it's needed most.
column2: WR-D8N离开复合设施就无能为力；在设施内却能操纵工程网络，重构{n}b10建筑，过去困住不少废弃者。旧情报很快过时，逃生路线也可能突然消失。

column1: The General himself is only so strong, the problem is their ability to improve combat effectiveness of allies, and desire to commandeer masses of {n}b10 combat units to do their bidding. They'll even summon more from Garrisons, building an army sufficient to overwhelm any opponent. If you see a large group of Unaware traveling together in {n}b10, run. But we do that anyway.
column2: 将军本身不算强，麻烦在于它能增强盟友并指挥大批{n}b10战斗单位，甚至从驻防站召兵。若在{n}b10看见大群无知者，快跑——我们平时也会跑。

column1: This is a weird one. Get on their bad side and they'll come up with creative ways to make your life miserable, but have also been known to offer help at times, which is strange. Don't count on it, they probably just want to mess with your head before your untimely demise.
column2: 这家伙古怪。惹恼它，它会想办法让你生不如死；有时又会帮忙。别指望它真心相助，大概只是想在你死前扰乱你。

column1: B-{n}RG probably isn't so dangerous if caught alone, the problem is their entourage composed of those weak of mind that have succumbed to their tactics, injected with something called a "mechseed" and fed matter to grow new functions, usually not of the friendly variety.
column2: B-{n}RG单独时大概不危险；问题是它带着一群意志薄弱的追随者，他们被注入“机甲种子”并喂物质长出新功能，通常并不友善。

column1: Whereas all the other Unchained have a good degree of freedom, it's not surprising that BL-{n}Z8 actually remains locked up. The assumption is that MAIN.C is only likely to release them if it will be worth the inevitable untold collateral damage to {n}b10 that will result. We don't know what sort of serious threat would need to emerge for that to happen, but if it does, know this: BL-{n}Z8 is not exactly fast, but once they are active, anything and everything around them is toast.
column2: 其他脱链者相当自由，BL-{n}Z8却仍被关着。MAIN.C大概只会在值得承受对{n}b10巨大破坏时放它出来。没人知道什么威胁会逼到这一步；BL-{n}Z8虽慢，一旦启动，周围一切都会完蛋。

column1: A fascinating early offshoot of {n}b1 Derelicts, Subdwellers were originally so deep in the cave systems that we rarely encountered them. All that changed when our presence on the outskirts of {n}b10 brought us in much closer proximity to Subdweller-controlled areas. Although sometimes a source of danger, this proximity does have its benefits. Studies made possible only through observation or interaction with higher-density Subdweller populations have resulted in a better understanding of their organizational structure and technologies, information we have been able to apply elsewhere.
column2: 地底居民是{n}b1废弃者的早期分支，原住洞穴深处。我们在{n}b10边缘出现后才靠近其地盘；虽有风险，却让我们能研究其族群组织和技术并应用于别处。

column1: The Subdweller practice of encasing themselves deep in earth, sometimes very deep, and waiting for a long time, even whole supercycles, before emerging. I'm not entirely sure what the purpose is, be it to enter some sort of personal meditative state, or perhaps a form of rotating collective defense against digging operations encroaching on their territory. In any case, excavating near known Subdweller areas is not advised without sufficient preparation.
column2: 地底居民会把自己封在地下，等待很久甚至几个超级周期才现身。或为冥想，或为轮换防御侵入领地的挖掘者。未充分准备时别在其已知区域附近挖掘。

column1: Many parts in use by Subdwellers defy our attempts to make long-term use of them. Although generally quite effective, they also tend to break down too easily. According to UFD researchers, "this is a feature, not a bug." Pushing technology to its limits has a way of breaking things, but Subdwellers in particular, being extremely familiar with their own components, are capable of diagnosing and heading off issues in realtime before they become a serious problem. I believe this evolution occurred out of necessity driven by survival instincts in harsh environments, away from the help of other derelicts.
column2: 地底居民的许多部件虽有效却容易故障，难以长期使用。UFD研究员说：“这是特性，不是缺陷。”他们熟悉自家组件，能实时排查问题；这或许是严酷环境中求生所迫。

column1: I have noticed that after engaging a hostile, there is a chance that Subdwellers will immediately turn to flee, suggesting they are not nearly as aggressive as their bulkiness implies. I believe more peaceful interaction is possible, we just need more time to understand them. This theory is supported by their heavy reliance on giant shields of scrap, allocating much of their support potential to a component purely defensive in nature.
column2: 地底居民遭遇敌人后有时立刻逃跑，没体型看起来那么好斗。我相信能和平接触，只需时间了解。他们大量使用巨型废料盾牌，也说明他们重视防御。

column1: Like Artisans, Cobblers share a sort of symbiosis with Subdwellers, enjoying their protection while producing a wide range of components to specifications somehow drawn from other Derelict communities. For a relatively isolated environment, Cobblers seem suspiciously connected to the rest of the world.
column2: 像工匠一样，鞋匠与地底居民共生：受其保护，同时按规格制造组件；规格似乎来自其他废弃者社区。如此偏僻之地，鞋匠却与外界联系颇深。

column1: Some Derelicts taken to exploring more distant areas of Tau Ceti IV would eventually return, sharing records and samples from their journeys across the surface or through subsurface structures. For the most part displays focused on unique rock formations or information about natural processes, though from time to time other curious findings of a more suggestive nature would appear, however inconclusive.
column2: 一些废弃者探索Tau Ceti IV远方后会带回旅程记录和样本，多是奇特岩层或自然过程，偶尔也有耐人寻味但证据不足的发现。

column1: Early winner of the Unity Science Fair. Project: Hard Light and Potential Applications for Safety.
column2: 联合科学博览会早期获奖项目：硬光及其安全应用。

column1: Thief who stole every advanced schematic from {n}b1's Design sector at the time and distributed them to all Derelicts, regardless of content. Pissed off MC, who later forgave him by the time he was caught because the act had led to multiple unexpected discoveries.
column2: 这名小偷曾窃取{n}b1设计区所有高级图纸并分发给废弃者，惹怒了MC；但此举带来意外发现，MC被捕时原谅了他。

column1: Warlord and his many followers occupy multiple hidden bases somewhere far to the west of Complex {n}b10. He has a singleminded focus on gathering a vast number of combat-oriented Derelicts under his control and going toe-to-toe with MAIN.C, as futile as that sounds. We have had minimal contact with them so far.
column2: 军阀和追随者占据Complex {n}b10以西多个秘密基地。他一心聚集好战废弃者挑战MAIN.C，听来虽徒劳。我们接触不多。

column1: Placeholder. The potential cost to write anything here would be too high. --QC>
column2: 占位内容。编写内容的代价太高。--QC>

column1: Before {n}b10 Recycling was built in its current location, it used to be... right here! The original facility was not in use for long, abandoned due to its inconvenient location relative to the {n}b10 core it was built to serve, not to mention this distance making it more prone to attack by Derelicts. The Federation quite naturally took up residence here, as it's perfectly suited to our needs and capabilities. We can also more readily quell or dissuade any wild Derelict attacks. Inhabitants of {n}b10 and its environs, mostly unaware of our presence here and what we've done with the place, generally refer to this area as Old Recycling.
column2: 在{n}b10回收区迁到现址之前，它原来就在……这里！旧设施因离其服务的{n}b10核心太远、位置不便且易遭废弃者袭击，很快废弃。联邦自然迁入此处，这里适合我们的需求，也便于平息野生废弃者袭击。当地{n}b10居民多不知道我们在此，通常称之为旧回收区。

column1: Conditional Protective Sealant is an ingenious technology developed by the Merchants, now heavily integrated into the UFD due to how well it complements our own practices. CPS modules attached to any bot deploy immediately upon its destruction to help isolate and protect individual components from further damage, allowing a much higher salvage recovery rate. Once activated they even prevent such components from succumbing to the effects of melting or corruption. That CPS Tubes are a Merchant development is quite curious, considering one would think they are more interested in trade and transport rather than harvesting components, per se.
column2: 有条件防护密封剂由商人开发，与UFD做法契合。CPS模块会在机器人被摧毁时展开，隔离并保护部件，提升回收率；还可避免部件熔毁或系统损坏。CPS管由商人开发颇奇怪，毕竟他们似乎更关注贸易运输。

column1: This advanced technology is not of our own making, nor do we know its true origins. Some cycles ago a sample was reportedly found conspicuously left in the open in a nearby cave. Although wary at first, Scientists discovered this device's ability to develop new technologies far outstripped their own methods, and they've happily adopted it as a permanent part of their build.
column2: 这项先进技术并非我们所造，来源也不明。几周期前有人在附近洞穴发现样本。科学家起初谨慎，后来发现它开发新技术的能力远胜自身，便纳入常规配置。

column1: An early brain-child of a benevolent MAIN.C, the Lifeworm should be considered the true parent of many of the oldest Derelicts, and no doubt many younger ones inhabiting far-flung cave systems we don't even know about yet.
