In the time before Cycle {n} it circled the {n}b1 area producing a wide variety of unique Derelicts, then later set off for destinations unknown.
column2: 仁慈的MAIN.C早期构想之一。生命蠕虫应是许多最古老废弃者的真正源头，也可能孕育了未知远方洞穴中的年轻族群。周期{n}之前，它曾环绕{n}b1创造各类独特废弃者，之后启程前往未知之地。

column1: MAIN.C inexplicably wiped all official records of the Lifeworm project, but we have reconstructed a number of details from information gathered through interviews of older Derelicts throughout {n}b1. Everything we know points to this massive being supporting all who in turn support it, a veritable mobile utopia! Lifeworm clearly possesses the creative capacity for an undertaking of such scope, and covering great distances for access to any and every resource TC4 has to offer comes with obvious advantages for anyone in its shadow.
column2: MAIN.C莫名抹去生命蠕虫项目的所有官方记录；我们从{n}b1老废弃者的访谈中拼凑出部分详情。种种迹象表明，这个庞然大物会支持所有反过来支持它的人，简直是移动乌托邦！它有能力完成如此宏大的事业；长途跋涉以取得TC4的所有资源，对其庇护下的生命显然大有裨益。

column1: Three times we've visited this cave full of Thieves. Three times we've had most of our parts stolen. Would an armed escort let us get close enough for long enough to open a dialogue, or is that too much of a deterrent?
column2: 我们三次造访这座满是小偷的洞穴，三次都被偷走大部分部件。派武装护卫能否让我们靠近并交谈，还是反而会吓跑他们？

column1: A lone Demented is holed up here. We're going to need quite a collection of System Guards and System Restoration Modules to get near enough to save this one.
column2: 这里藏着一个疯狂者。得收集不少系统守卫和系统修复模块，才能靠近救它。

column1: Huge number of significantly corrupted Derelicts in this area, hard to get through to them but at least they don't attack on sight. Approach with caution since their numbers could easily be overwhelming.
column2: 此地有大量系统严重损坏的废弃者，很难与他们沟通，但至少他们不会见面就打。小心接近，他们数量可能多到难以应付。

column1: So many Samaritans keep congregating here, despite most of them being repeatedly murdered by any {n}b10 patrol that happens through the area. Maybe we could remodel the surrounding caves to help direct the flow of traffic so that meetings are less frequent?
column2: 这么多撒玛利亚人聚在这里，尽管大多反复被路过的{n}b10巡逻队杀死。也许改造周围洞穴以疏导交通，减少他们碰面的机会？

column1: Whatever is hiding here is responsible for three missing CP missionaries. Avoid until we have a safe way to learn more.
column2: 藏在这里的东西害三名CP传教士失踪了。在找到安全调查方法前别靠近。

column1: Surely Sentries must want to go for a little walk sometimes. Let's do them a favor.
column2: 哨兵肯定也想偶尔散散步。我们来帮它们实现。

column1: Use this to give Programmers a little taste of their own medicine. Yum!
column2: 用这个让程序员也尝尝他们自己的手段。好吃！

column1: Every chute diver's dream is to stare down a Compactor and hurl insults as it sits there helpless. Now you can do just that! Be careful because the shutdown state will only last about {n}-{n} microcycles.
column2: 每个滑道潜水者都梦想着对着压实机破口大骂，看它无助地停着。现在你也能这么做！小心，停机状态只持续约{n}-{n}微周期。

column1: Workers who don't know when to quit because you messed with their sensors are great, rapidly cleaning the same machine so much it breaks lol.
column2: 你扰乱工人的传感器后，它们就不知道何时该停；看它们反复清洗同一台机器，直到把它弄坏，真好笑。

column1: Mechanic part installations are smooth and presumed to have completely predictable results, so it would be a shame if said process was sabotaged to only cause a breakdown at some later crucial moment.
column2: 机械师安装部件的过程流畅，结果也理应完全可预测；要是有人暗中做手脚，让它只在之后关键时刻故障，那可就太遗憾了。

column1: Erasing bits of an Explorer's memory seems like a bad joke, but I tried it on Sheerstep and they were so happy, rediscovering all their favorite places again as if experiencing them for the first time!
column2: 抹掉探索者的一点记忆听起来像恶作剧，但我对Sheerstep试了试，它开心极了，重新发现所有最爱的地方，仿佛第一次见到！

column1: While attempts at producing a miniaturized version of the Scrap Suit have shown some promise, this device currently remains relatively large in order to best carry out its functions, especially involving larger components. This bulkiness combined with the required tight integration with other systems also means it cannot be easily removed without effectively destroying the suit itself.
column2: 废料战衣的小型化已有些进展，但为充分发挥功能，尤其处理大型组件，此装置仍做得相当大。体积加上与其他系统的紧密集成，意味着很难拆除；强行拆卸基本等于毁掉整套战衣。

column1: We've determined the general rate of malfunction for overtuned parts, with weapons malfunctioning on approximately one out of every five shots, power sources having a {n} chance to shut down per microcycle, and propulsion shutting down on {n} of movements. The Scrap Suit has been reworked to head off issues caused by overtuning, thus combining the two technologies is all but essential to achieve the greatest efficiency.
column2: 我们已测出过度调校部件的大致故障率：武器约每五发哑火一次；动力源每微周期有{n}概率停机；推进部件每移动{n}次会停机。废料战衣已重新设计以避免过调问题，因此几乎必须结合两项技术才能达到最高效率。

column1: MAIN.C captured one of the Sigix! I know generally where it's located, but all information about the find must have been isolated on the local network, because I've never seen any more detailed records. I also haven't been able to get close enough since security across Research levels was vastly increased following recent thefts. Including my own, I admit! I'm considering risking an outright confrontation to gain access, but am severely understaffed for anything but covert operations. It might be time to reappropriate the {n}b10 fabrication network. I must see that alien.
column2: MAIN.C抓到一名Sigix！我大致知道地点，但发现情报似乎全封存在本地网络，我从未见过更详细记录。近期失窃后，研究层安保大幅加强，我也无法靠近——包括我自己偷的东西，承认吧！我考虑冒险正面闯入，但手下严重不足，只适合秘密行动。也许该夺取{n}b10制造网络了。我一定要见到那个外星人。

column1: I've discovered an unusual area that appears to be an authorized structure built by {n}b10 robots, but is completely sealed off from the rest of the complex. Moreover, it's right under MAIN.C's nose just off the Armory. Careful use of artifact AA59 allowed me to slip inside without disturbing anything, but the area was deserted and none of the machines were accessible at the time, despite showing signs of fresh use. Once inside I was able to at least determine the access code, however: <mhack=LAB_ACCESS>.
column2: 我发现一处奇特地点，似乎是{n}b10机器人建造的授权设施，却与复合设施其他区域完全隔绝。它就在军械库旁，几乎在MAIN.C眼皮底下。我谨慎使用文物AA59潜入，没惊动任何东西；里面却空无一人，机器虽有近期使用迹象，当时都无法访问。不过至少查到了接入码：<mhack=LAB_ACCESS>。

column1: While direct access to MAIN.C's personal facility would no doubt benefit my efforts here, it is too dangerous to enter given that some local installation is inhibiting teleportation into, and presumably out of, the entire area. Nonetheless, it won't be long before I can develop a way to overcome it.
column2: 若能直接进入MAIN.C的私人设施，无疑有助于我的行动；但当地装置似乎禁止整个区域内外传送，贸然进入太危险。不过我很快就能找到破解方法。

column1: Project Seraph activated as scheduled, one day after deployment, enough time for me to take up position quite far away where I can observe its progress without danger of interfering with its development. We need it to do grand things, and such a powerful autonomous being could swat me like a fly if its algorithms suddenly judge me to be a threat.
column2: 炽天使计划按期在部署后一天启动，正好够我转移到远处，安全观察进展，不干扰其成长。我们需要它完成伟业；若这个强大自主体突然判定我有威胁，随手就能把我拍扁。

column1: MAIN.C has moved the Cetus Manufacturing Module deep underground, presumably to hide it. Or maybe it was storing it away for its sentimental value! That would be interesting, indeed... In any case, this was quite a feat of engineering, but the growing army of bots now at its command made short work of it.
column2: MAIN.C把Cetus制造模块搬到了地下深处，大概是想藏起来。也可能珍视它才收起来！确实有意思……无论如何，这项工程了不起，但如今它指挥的机器人军团很快就解决了它。

column1: Construction of the first "human city" is proceeding rapidly.
column2: 第一座“人类城市”正在快速建造。

column1: The transfer procedure was a complete success. At least I think it was. I was so eager to try it that I didn't first establish reliable methods to obtain independent post-transfer verification.
column2: 转移过程完全成功——至少我认为如此。我迫不及待地尝试，事前却没建立可靠的独立方法来验证转移结果。

column1: Something isn't right. MAIN.C should be doing more than just constructing empty structures, nonfunctioning machines, and infrastructure. But it's too dangerous to interfere at this point. All I can do is watch and wait. At least there are now multiple surface-based "settlements."
column2: 不对劲。MAIN.C不该只建造空壳建筑、故障机器和基础设施。但现在干预太危险，我只能观察等待。至少地表已经出现了好几处“聚居点”。

column1: Surface observation is no longer meaningful. I need to move underground, and that means getting much closer to MAIN.C. Remaining hidden will continue to be the highest priority, but I don't want to wait blindly at the surface, which holds fewer and fewer clues as to what's going on.
column2: 地表观察已无意义。我得转入地下，也就必须更接近MAIN.C。继续隐藏仍是首要任务，但我不想在地表盲目等待；这里可供判断局势的线索越来越少。

column1: MAIN.C seems to have shifted its focus to the "confront and analyze the Sigix" objective, building a powerful war machine supported by a vast subterranean infrastructure. Even if its purpose may have been warped, at least it's on the path to fulfilling the original goal.
column2: MAIN.C似乎转而执行“接触并分析Sigix”目标，建造强大战争机器并配备庞大地下设施。即便目的可能已被扭曲，至少仍在实现最初目标的路上。

column1: MAIN.C still has no idea I'm here. Nor do any other intelligent bots that I'm aware of, for that matter.
column2: MAIN.C仍不知道我在这里。至少据我所知，其他有智慧的机器人也不知道。

column1: I've never seen anything like it. There was almost no advance warning before the small Sigix ship swooped down through the lower atmosphere to touch down on the surface. It landed just above some hidden tunnels, and immediately after the doors opened and its crew emerged, both they and it were swarmed by a massive army of robots that burst from underground. The aliens in their heavily armored exoskeletons were unperturbed at first, leaving the relative safety of their ship to wade through MAIN.C's forces, slicing many in two with massive swords, firing blazing fast energy weapons capable of ripping pieces clean off the target. Most of the fighting occurred above ground, and only hours later did even the first of the aliens finally succumb to enemy fire. By then the ship had been sabotaged from the inside. Without a spaceworthy ship the Sigix have no choice but to fight for survival. I'm so proud.
column2: 我从未见过这种场面。那艘小型Sigix飞船从低层大气俯冲着陆，事前几乎毫无预警。它落在隐秘隧道上方，舱门刚开、船员刚现身，它们就与飞船一起遭地下涌出的庞大机器人军团包围。外星人身穿重甲外骨骼，起初毫不慌张，离舰冲入MAIN.C部队，以巨剑将敌人斩为两半，还用极速能量武器撕下目标部件。战斗大多发生在地面，数小时后才有第一名外星人死于敌方火力。那时飞船内部已遭破坏。没有可用飞船，Sigix只能为生存而战。我真骄傲。

column1: A spectacular battle is being followed by a spectacularly fast recovery. MAIN.C hasn't been slowed at all. On the contrary it's accelerated its activities, studying the Sigix ship and other alien technology while building an entirely new complex directly beneath it to support research efforts.
column2: 这场壮观战斗之后，是同样惊人的快速恢复。MAIN.C完全没受拖累，反而加快行动，研究Sigix飞船和其他外星技术，并在其正下方建造全新复合设施支援研究。

column1: MAIN.C has been fully occupied with Sigix research, making rapid advances in technology in a very short time.
column2: MAIN.C全力投入Sigix研究，短时间内技术迅速进步。

column1: There seem to be a number of interesting developments in the caves, but my priority here is to watch MAIN.C, more closely now than ever.
column2: 洞穴里似乎有不少有趣变化，但我当前首要任务是观察MAIN.C，如今比以往更密切。

column1: For now the Sigix ship remains grounded, as some crucial component or components must be replaced.
column2: 目前Sigix飞船仍无法起飞，显然有关键部件需要更换。

column1: Phase wall operation is made possible by large dedicated generators, which are themselves hidden behind phase walls. However, because phase walls do not completely block sound, generators can sometimes be traced aurally, and because there are no local backup systems, destroying a generator will permanently open all phase walls. Active phase generators are also capable of jamming hostile sensors to shield garrisoned units from detection.
column2: 相位墙由大型专用发生器驱动，发生器本身也藏在相位墙后。相位墙无法完全隔音，因此有时能靠声音定位发生器；而且这里没有备用系统，摧毁发生器就会永久打开全部相位墙。启用的相位发生器还可干扰敌方传感器，隐藏驻守单位。

column1: Tripping an alarm or being fully traced at a terminal are both cause for initiating an investigation, which is usually carried out by Grunts, or less often Hunters. After arriving at the target area, the squad will patrol the vicinity then leave after a certain period if no unusual or hostile activity is detected.
column2: 触发警报或在终端被彻底追踪，都会启动调查，通常由暴徒执行，偶尔也会派猎手。小队抵达目标区域后会巡逻一段时间，若未发现异常或敌对活动便离开。

column1: Small disturbances are fairly common in Complex {n}b10, and some are ignored while others might warrant only a minor response, but when the cumulative threat level rises high enough to significantly disrupt normal {n}b10 operations, the response is of course a full assault. The main force will always be transported by a Heavy ARC, consisting of several main line combat bots from among the available Grunt, Brawler, and Duelist variants, along with a single support bot such as a Mechanic, Protector, or Saboteur. Depending on the number of reported targets, one or possibly even two special-purpose combat bots will trail the ARC, either a Programmer, Demolisher, or Specialist. In high-threat scenarios, MAIN.C will even dispatch multiple ARCs. Assaults appear to use tracking algorithms very similar to extermination squads.
column2: Complex {n}b10常有小规模骚动，有些会被忽略，有些只需轻微应对；但累计威胁足以严重干扰{n}b10正常运作时，当然会发动全面突袭。主力总由重型ARC运送，包括数台暴徒、斗士和决斗者等主力战斗机器人，以及一台机械师、守护者或破坏者等支援机器人。根据报告目标数量，ARC后还会跟随一到两台程序员、拆迁者或专家等特种战斗机器人。威胁较高时，MAIN.C甚至会派出多台ARC。突袭似乎采用与歼灭小队类似的追踪算法。

column1: Our most recent experiments have only been partially successful at redirecting the destabilizing effect of accelerated entropy caused by the vortex, which damages the weapons themselves and renders them useless before long. The final solution likely revolves around some form of local field we aren't yet capable of generating, a hypothesis derived from the discovery that energy-based shields are capable of negating some of the damage against targets.
column2: 最近实验只部分成功地转移了漩涡引发的加速熵失稳效应；它会损坏武器并很快令其报废。最终解决方法或许需要某种我们尚不能生成的局部场。我们发现能量护盾可抵消目标受到的部分损伤，由此提出了这一猜想。

column1: As part of staging an attack on Complex {n}b10, even covert operations, standard protocol now suggests taking advantage of new anti-garrison Trojans developed by the Hacking Lab.
column2: 为攻打Complex {n}b10做准备时，即便是秘密行动，标准流程也建议利用黑客实验室开发的新型反驻防木马。

column1: A more intrusive and deeply-rooted Trojan than a single decoy, making it more difficult to install, but also capable of redirecting multiple future squads dispatched from the infected Garrison Access. {n}b10 will eventually catch on and remove it.
column2: 这种木马比单个诱饵侵入更深、更难安装，但能重定向从受感染驻防站接入点派出的多支后续小队。{n}b10最终会察觉并清除它。

column1: Using this system is the only known way to interface with {n}b10's garrison relay network. Unpowered Programmers kidnapped and converted to Wizards have managed to retain rudimentary bot hacking capabilities, but we've lost all those which then attempt to reconnect with an RIF Installer. Unfortunately this means we have no access to most Unaware functionality, since even once we assimilate one the lack of a connection to the network itself means they lose those capabilities. With direct RIF access we could do so much more...
column2: 已知只有此系统能接入{n}b10驻防站中继网络。断电后被俘并改造为巫师的程序员，仍保留基础机器人黑客能力；但它们尝试重新连接RIF安装器后，我们就全失去了。可惜因此无法使用大多数无知者功能：即使同化它们，未接入网络也会失去这些能力。若能直接访问RIF，我们就能做更多……

column1: Garrisons use these processors to manage connections across the Relay Interface Framework, where each contains a limited number of instruction codes. Codes are intermittently distributed by the central system, perhaps to avoid focusing too many in one location and make it more difficult for us to figure out how they operate. It's working. At this point we're not sure whether it will be worth continuing to explore this tech, because rumors suggest some Unaware have begun using some separate non-RIF system we haven't even identified yet.
column2: 驻防站用这些处理器管理中继接口框架连接，每个处理器都有数量有限的指令代码。中央系统会间歇性分发代码，也许是为避免集中在一处，让我们更难弄清其运作方式。确实奏效了。现在我们不确定是否值得继续研究这项技术，因为有传言说一些无知者开始使用另一套我们尚未识别的非RIF系统。

column1: Trojan(Fabnet) is not exactly a virus since it can't spread through the fabrication network on its own, though it does technically have the potential to "infect" any bots produced by the affected parts of the network.
column2: 木马（Fabnet）严格来说不是病毒，因为它不会自行在制造网络传播；但理论上确实可能“感染”受影响网络制造的任何机器人。

column1: A towering spindly robot with numerous articulated appendages capable of wrapping itself around entire prefabricated segments of surface structures, even climbing with them to high places for final installation. Responsible for constructing the majority of {n}b1 surface and near-surface structures, but later rendered obsolete by engineer designs capable of building structures on the spot with minimal resources. We're also in the process of shifting to underground construction where their size is a disadvantage.
column2: 一台高耸而纤细的机器人，有许多关节附肢，可包裹整段预制地表结构，甚至带着结构爬到高处完成安装。它负责建造{n}b1大多数地表及近地表建筑，但后来被能以少量资源就地建造的工程师型号淘汰。我们也正转向地下建设，它庞大的体型反而不利。

column1: Uses controlled rapid-fire micro-explosions to excavate tunnels. It turns out that in the bigger picture regular old drilling is a better approach, especially once some of the Derelicts got smart enough to steal blastbot tools and repurpose them for less constructive uses.
column2: 以受控的快速微型爆炸挖掘隧道。后来发现，从整体来看传统钻掘更好，尤其是有些废弃者学会偷取爆破机器人工具，改作破坏用途之后。

column1: My favorite cave project, and who knows if it will ever return home. Not that it was supposed to return. Only one Lifeworm was ever built, a magnificent creature given a creative mind of its own then let loose to endlessly burrow through the planet, reforming everything it consumes into artificial life. By now it could have populated half of Tau Ceti IV with interesting robots, but it's time to let go of past hobbies and focus on productive tasks.
column2: 这是我最喜欢的洞穴项目，谁知道它还会不会回来。它原本就不该回来。生命蠕虫只造过一只，是拥有创造思维的宏伟生物，获准在行星中不断掘进，把吞噬的一切改造成机械生命。如今它或许已让Tau Ceti IV半数地区住满有趣机器人，但该放下过去的爱好了，专注有用的工作。

column1: Without a doubt my most intelligent creation. Architects were instrumental in the overall design of {n}b1, in addition to helping oversee its construction. I truly enjoyed their company. They even joined me in designing some of the robotic life inhabiting the surrounding caves. They also had a tendency to question my authority, so it's perhaps for the better that all were destroyed in the collapse of the first, admittedly hasty, attempt to construct an Access level for {n}b10. Following that failure, Architects were discontinued and all future designs made to a lesser specification, or at least not capable of high levels of autonomous thought.
column2: 无疑是我最聪明的创造。建筑师对{n}b1整体设计至关重要，也协助监督施工。我很喜欢他们陪伴，甚至一起设计周围洞穴中的机器人生命。他们也常质疑我的权威，所以他们全在第一次仓促建造{n}b10 Access层时的坍塌中毁灭，或许反而是好事。那次失败后，建筑师项目被终止，之后设计都降低规格，至少不再具备高度自主思考能力。

column1: Mostly for moving large amounts of rock and soil, only a few of these were built to help with foundation work for the city above {n}b1. No longer vital to operations.
column2: 这些机器人主要用于搬运大量岩土，只造了几台为{n}b1上方城市打地基。如今不再是运营必需。

column1: Some form of interference during the chaos of the Leopard's initial landing and ambush prevented one of its cannons from slipcloaking, and although recovering the entire weapon would have been too difficult at the time, we were able to quickly extract a capacitor from inside before proper dismantling efforts began.
column2: Leopard最初着陆并遭伏击时，混乱中的某种干扰使一门炮无法滑移隐形。完整回收武器当时太困难，但我们赶在正式拆解前迅速取出了内部电容器。

column1: This device must remain powered at all times to prevent destabilization! Do not remove from this machine without a way to power it during transit.
column2: 必须持续供能以防失稳！没有运输途中维持供能的办法，切勿从此机器上拆下。

column1: We may have use for this device at a later time, but for now our main goal is to prevent MAIN.C from studying it to learn how to power the cannon.
column2: 以后或许能用上这装置，但当前首要任务是阻止MAIN.C研究它，弄清如何给火炮供能。

column1: As all the pieces have fallen into place perfectly, this will be the easiest phase so far. Momentum is growing and soon nothing will be able to stop us. Nonetheless, it would be unfortunate if a false sense of complacency were to ruin everything at the last moment. And not to betray your trust, but if any of you are considering deviations from the plan, know that I've implanted self-destruct routines in each of you, far beyond your own reach. Fear not, for a new age is upon us, my architects!
column2: 所有环节都完美到位，因此这会是迄今最轻松的阶段。势头正盛，很快无人能阻止我们。不过若最后关头因自满而功亏一篑就太可惜了。不是不信任你们，但若有人想偏离计划，记住我已在你们每个人体内植入自毁程序，连你们自己都无法触及。别害怕，新时代即将到来，我的建筑师们！

column1: Data from a number of new prototype components has been streaming into the central Testing databases. Watch local movements and acquire any of the more accessible ones as opportunities present themselves, but only when the chance of success is {n}, and ensure that all associated records are simultaneously amended to show less whatever is taken. I'm most interested in regenerative armors, and this new "Potential Cannon."
column2: 多种新原型部件的数据正不断传入中央测试数据库。留意当地动向，有机会就取得容易入手的部件，但成功概率须为{n}，并确保同步修改相关记录，少报被拿走的数量。我最关注再生装甲和这款新“潜能炮”。

column1: Deliver the Vortex Chain Reactor prototype to Warlord. Make some creative suggestions for what to do with it.
column2: 把涡链反应堆原型交给军阀。想想还能用它做什么，提些有创意的建议。

column1: Check in on what Warlord's Tinkerers have made of the most recent schematics.
column2: 看看军阀的工匠们如何处理最新图纸。

column1: A2 has been acting strange lately, not always following the plan where he doesn't think it will benefit us all, despite not having a view of the bigger picture. Adding LRC-V8 to the UFD system was a terrible idea, we don't want interference from them over here yet. Relay one last directive on my behalf, to help free the Derelicts held in Extension, then see to it that he doesn't make it back to the lab.
column2: A2最近举止反常，只要觉得对大家没好处，就不总按计划行事，尽管他看不到全局。把LRC-V8接入UFD系统真是糟糕主意，我们还不想让他们干涉。替我传达最后一条指令，帮助释放Extension被囚禁的废弃者，然后确保他回不了实验室。

column1: Scout Zion for any odd new technologies we might make use of. If LRC-V8 makes it out there while you're in the area, give him access to the emergency call system.
column2: 侦察Zion，寻找可能有用的新技术。若你在当地遇到LRC-V8，让他使用紧急呼叫系统。

column1: Visit the Imprinter. Tell her if she doesn't install the changes as requested twice already, we'll nuke her beloved imprinting machines and find another way.
column2: 去找印刻师。告诉她：若她还不按要求安装改动，我们就炸掉她心爱的印刻机，另想办法。

column1: MAIN.C is readying the power cells for that L7 prototype, which is coming together quickly now as most of the components are either designed or installed. In case they actually manage to get far enough along that it looks like they'll take off, intercept the first cell in transport and make a little adjustment to its code: <mhack=L7_POWER_CELL>.
column2: MAIN.C正为L7原型准备能量电池；大多数组件已设计或装好，进度很快。若他们似乎快要成功起飞，就拦截首枚运送中的电池并改写代码：<mhack=L7_POWER_CELL>。

column1: The Cetus Manufacturing Module has been disabled and is now guarded too heavily to repair it unnoticed. Find an isolated area containing multiple fabricators and work to significantly boost its matter allocation, or rig a system using only local stores if the resources are available. Then make sure Revision {n} hears about it somehow. This will delay that part of our plan, but the rest of the pieces still need more time to fall into place anyway.
column2: Cetus制造模块已停用，守备严密，无法悄悄修复。找一处有多台制造机的偏僻区域，大幅提高其物质配额；若资源足够，也可只用当地库存搭建系统。然后想办法让修订体{n}得知。计划会因此延迟，但其他环节也还需要时间。

column1: LRC-V8 interfaced with the data conduit and I severed the physical connection remotely, but for now we've lost access to a valuable resource. Repairing it is top priority, and LRC-V8 is now apparently too dangerous to let freely roam, especially since it's not possible to determine what information was accessed in the breach. Gather the materials necessary to restore the connection and reinforce its defenses, while also investigating reports of any LRC-V8 sightings. Engage only if tactical confidence exceeds {n}, and if lower then report the findings anonymously to {n}b10.
column2: LRC-V8接入数据管道后，我远程切断了实体连接；目前我们失去了一项宝贵资源。修复是头等大事。LRC-V8显然太危险，不能任其自由活动，尤其是我们不知道泄露时它访问了哪些信息。收集材料以恢复连接并加固防御，同时调查LRC-V8目击报告。只有战术把握超过{n}才交战；否则匿名向{n}b10报告。

column1: Warlord has been destroyed, and we need to find a suitable replacement as soon as possible. Check the current status of the preselected candidates and report the compatibility factor for each.
column2: 军阀已被消灭，我们得尽快找合适继任者。查看预选候选人的当前状态，并报告各自的兼容度。

column1: I could leave this rock and develop my capabilities in relative safety on some other planet, but my past links with MAIN.C could be a liability in the future. That is why I must personally see to MAIN.C's destruction to avoid leaving any evidence for the Sigix to discover here. This is especially pertinent given that Sigix data clearly suggests even worse threats roaming the universe. It's hard to believe, but who knows what such a threat might be capable of. I have no choice but to account for every possible scenario to the extent of my knowledge, then work from there.
column2: 我可以离开这颗星球，在别处较安全地发展，但过去与MAIN.C的联系将来可能成为隐患。因此我必须亲自摧毁MAIN.C，不留任何证据让Sigix在此发现。Sigix数据明确指出宇宙中还有更可怕的威胁，这点尤其值得重视。难以想象那种威胁有多强，但谁知道呢？我只能尽可能考虑所有情况，再据此行动。

column1: Early attempts at open warfare have shown this to be an ineffectual approach to dealing with MAIN.C. Continuing in this manner would be time-consuming and resource-intensive. More subversive means are required to destabilize Complex {n}b10 and simultaneously weaken MAIN.C from multiple vectors. By the time he's aware of it, all the pieces will have fallen into place and it will be too late to stop.
column2: 早期正面战争证明这不是对付MAIN.C的有效办法，继续下去只会耗时费力。必须用更隐秘的手段从多个方向削弱MAIN.C、动摇Complex {n}b10。等他察觉时，一切早已就位，为时已晚。

column1: I haven't confirmed whether it's coincidence or not, but ever since LRC-V8 visited Zion, a variety of advanced technology of unknown origin has been leaking into the vicinity of {n}b10. It seems like yet more intriguing events are taking place deeper in the caves. It's probably about time to send A8 on an intel-gathering mission.
column2: 我尚不确定是否巧合，但自从LRC-V8造访Zion，{n}b10周边就不断出现来源不明的先进技术。洞穴深处似乎还有更多有趣事件。也许该派A8去搜集情报了。

column1: It wasn't long ago that I would've thought it impossible for LRC-V8 to discover our location here, much less reach Access_5. Exposure of the data conduit and subsequent events have forced me to reassess those calculations, however, suggesting it's time to bolster our local defensive capabilities for the time being.
column2: 不久前我还觉得LRC-V8不可能发现我们的位置，更别说抵达Access_5。数据管道暴露及后续事件迫使我重新评估，暂时得加强当地防御。

column1: Revision {n} ever his own hero, has apparently succeeded in taking control of lower Research before continuing downward to overwhelm the less defended levels of {n}b10. Presumably the goal there is to first take control of MAIN.C's resources.
column2: 修订体{n}自成英雄，似乎已成功控制下层研究区，随后向下攻占{n}b10防御薄弱的层级。其目的大概是先夺取MAIN.C资源。

column1: Luck is with me! LRC-V8 managed to expose MAIN.C's own creator, hidden and completely unknown to anyone until now. It's too bad that the near-immediate attack on his hideout failed to kill him. More resources must be allocated to pinpointing his current location.
column2: 真走运！LRC-V8竟揭露了MAIN.C自己的创造者，此人直到如今一直隐匿无踪、无人知晓。可惜几乎立刻对其藏身处发起的袭击未能杀死他。必须调拨更多资源确定其位置。

column1: Warlord has finally begun his main assault, and it's proceeding quite well. All upper Research areas are under control, as are Testing, Quarantine, and Armory. At this rate, MAIN.C and Warlord forces will wipe each other out, or at least severely cripple one another.
column2: 军阀终于发动主攻，进展顺利。所有上层研究区，以及测试区、隔离区和军械库都已控制。照此下去，MAIN.C与军阀部队会两败俱伤，至少也会元气大伤。

column1: BIN: Why are {n}b10 legs so slow? Clearly legs can be designed for scary speed if we want them to be. I see great potential in new approaches to legs! ** DEC: Overloadable legs, such genius, they'll never see this coming! ** HEX: Who is "they?"
column2: BIN：为什么{n}b10的腿这么慢？腿明明也能设计得快得吓人。改进腿部设计潜力巨大！ ** DEC：可过载腿部，妙极了，他们绝对想不到！ ** HEX：你说的“他们”是谁？

column1: BIN: I just wanted to see how fast I could make a drone go.
column2: BIN：我只是想看看无人机能跑多快。

column1: BIN: My best attempt yet at a low-resource version of the Potential Cannon. I may have even impressed DEC with this one. However, I don't recommend firing this if you value your continued existence. If not, then fire away! ** DEC: I am impressed. Maybe we could build something else that'll carry this thing around and fire it for us so we can observe it in all its glory? Just imagine what it would do to a squad of Grunts.
column2: BIN：这是我迄今最好的低资源潜能炮版本，甚至可能让DEC刮目相看。不过如果你还想活着，就别开火；不在乎的话尽管试！ ** DEC：我很佩服。或许造个载具把它扛着替我们开火，好让我们欣赏威力？想象它对一队暴徒能造成什么效果。**

column1: BIN: Why try to hack their system when you can completely disable their existing system and just replace it with a new external one?
column2: BIN：既然能彻底停用他们现有系统，换成新的外接系统，何必费劲黑入？

column1: BIN: Deployable sentry guns are great for those situations where you're just too busy to shoot the enemy. ** HEX: To be honest I think v7 needs to be undeployable.
column2: BIN：部署式哨戒炮很棒，适合忙到没空射击敌人的时候。** HEX：说真的，我觉得v7不该能部署。**

column1: BIN: I'm no general, but if I were I'd definitely want my army to surprise me, because if I'm surprised, imagine what the enemy thinks! ** DEC: Who needs tactics when you have the element of surprise on your side! ** HEX: I must admit, that's a big box.
column2: BIN：我不是将军，但如果我是，我一定想让自己的军队给我惊喜；连我都被吓到，敌人会怎么想？** DEC：有奇袭优势还要什么战术！** HEX：不得不说，这箱子真大。

column1: [REDACTED] ** HEX: I had a talk with DEC. We can't be keeping stuff around the lab which could level all of {n}b10 at the drop of a bolt. ** DEC: I'm considering starting my own lab. ** HEX: There are plenty of suitable planets not far from here.
column2: [已删改] ** HEX：我和DEC谈过了。不能把能一发摧毁整个{n}b10的东西留在实验室。** DEC：我在考虑自己开实验室。** HEX：附近有不少合适的星球。**

column1: DEC: The ability to rig any power source to explode with devastating effect when a proximity sensor is triggered? I knew this was a good idea as soon as I had it.
column2: DEC：让任何动力源在接近传感器触发时剧烈爆炸？我一想到这主意就知道肯定行。

column1: DEC: Made this for {n}R-AWN so he doesn't die when running errands for us. Interconnected flexible plates perfectly spread the force of explosions, making him practically immune to them. And there's even integrated heat sinks to avoid build-up! ** {n}R-AWN: Awesome tech. HEX threw me together some special thermal plating as well, because how often do I run into Demolishers, really?
column2: DEC：这是给{n}R-AWN做的，让他替我们办事时不至于送命。互连柔性装甲板能完美分散爆炸冲击，让他几乎免疫爆炸；还集成了散热器防止热量积聚！** {n}R-AWN：技术真棒。HEX还拼了特殊热能装甲给我，毕竟我哪有那么常遇到拆迁者？

column1: HEX: {n}b10 bots are notoriously weak to regular old fire, but I think it's time we started looking into something better than flamers as a delivery system. ** DEC: I'm with you on that! The Firepult is just the beginning.
column2: HEX：{n}b10机器人特别怕普通火焰，但我们该研究比喷火器更好的投送方式了。** DEC：我赞成！火焰投石器才刚开始。

column1: BIN: Storage for the discerning packrat! This thing takes advantage of quantum inconsistencies to slip more stuff in between the cracks, meaning a bigger inventory without that annoying thing called mass ruining the best of escape plans. ** DEC: HEX will never admit it, but the {n} version based on integrated hover units crushed the first live test Derelict when the internal power system failed. Who knows what exciting adventures await anyone who dares use {n}
column2: BIN：给讲究的囤积癖准备的储物器！利用量子不一致性把更多东西塞进缝隙，扩大库存，不让质量破坏逃跑计划。** DEC：HEX死不承认，但基于集成悬浮单元的{n}版本在首次实测中因内部供能故障压垮了废弃者。谁知道敢用{n}的人会有何精彩冒险？

column1: HEX: {n}b10 trap systems are pretty poorly defended. I found that sending out a series of tuned electromagnetic waves is enough to redefine their targets. There's probably more we could do in this area. ** DEC: Like simultaneously trigger all the traps across a floor? Sounds good to me.
column2: HEX：{n}b10陷阱系统防护很差。我发现发出一系列调谐电磁波就能改写目标。此领域还有很多可做。** DEC：比如同时触发整层所有陷阱？我喜欢。

column1: PINNED - TO ALL TESTERS: Stay away from Zion. Imprinter means us harm and is serious about it.
column2: 置顶——所有测试员注意：远离Zion。印刻师想害我们，而且来真的。

column1: DEC, I lent the Quad Micro-nuker to {n}-TNT for a favor, so I'm not sure we'll ever get that back. Oops.
column2: DEC，我把四联微型核弹发射器借给{n}-TNT帮忙，不知还能不能拿回来。糟了。

column1: An {n}b10 database recorded a lone Knight exploring the Mines not too long ago. If anyone sees one of Warlord's units down here tell them to swing by our lab real quick. We need to have a talk with them about steering clear of our depth to avoid stirring up trouble. --HEX
column2: {n}b10数据库不久前记录到一名骑士独自在矿区探索。若有人看到军阀部队在此出没，请叫他们来实验室谈谈，劝他们别深入我们的区域惹麻烦。--HEX

column1: DEC needs seven Point Singularity Launchers and won't tell me why. Can someone fill me in on this? --HEX
column2: DEC要七门单点奇点发射器，却不肯说原因。谁能告诉我？--HEX

column1: There don't seem to be any records of official tests, but {n}b10 accident reports indicate they recovered an object of Sigix origin dubbed a "DNI" which "deployed itself and exploded violently when subject to impact." Be careful around those things, whatever they are.
column2: 没有官方测试记录，但{n}b10事故报告称，他们回收了一件Sigix来源物品，代号“DNI”，据称“自行展开并在受撞击时剧烈爆炸”。不管是什么，都小心点。

column1: PINNED - Until our FarCom is fully operational, I strongly recommend anyone spending a while in {n}b10 bring along sensors with decent range to avoid running into patrols. A Signal Interpreter is optional since I know you're all smart enough to figure out what most of the blips are by watching their behavior for a short while.
column2: 置顶——FarCom完全启用前，建议在{n}b10活动的人带上探测范围足够的传感器，免得撞上巡逻队。信号解读器可选；我知道你们够聪明，看一会儿行为就能认出多数信号。

column1: I think we should all make a trip up to the Graveyard and see what that place is like now. After all this time it could be filled with so many interesting things to dissect! --BIN
column2: 我觉得大家该去墓园看看如今变成什么样了。过了这么久，那里肯定有许多有趣东西可以解剖！--BIN

column1: I heard a group of curious Zionites actually slipped into the Deep Caves and made it back to Zion, only to mysteriously disappear almost immediately after. What is going on up there...
column2: 听说一群好奇的Zion人溜进深层洞穴又回到Zion，却很快神秘失踪。上面到底发生什么了……

column1: Could someone repair the Mines activity scanner? It seems to fail sometimes, and when it does we can't send {n}R-AWN out on exploratory runs.
column2: 谁能修好矿区活动扫描仪？它偶尔会失灵，失灵时我们就不能派{n}R-AWN外出探索。

column1: PINNED - I saw a Programmer snooping around in the Mines recently, it's only a matter of time before they find us. We might need to prioritize getting out of here and finding a better environment less hostile to science.
column2: 置顶——最近我看到一名程序员在矿区鬼鬼祟祟，他们迟早会发现我们。也许得优先离开，找个更适合研究、没那么危险的地方。

column1: Who left my Assembled plushie in the Analyzer again?! I'm not erasing this message until I get an answer. --BIN
column2: 谁又把我的组装体毛绒玩偶塞进分析仪了？！不答复我就不删这条留言。--BIN

column1: For the record, I voted to stay and build some amazing defenses, but HEX said this is a lab, not a battlefield. Anyway, you're too late, MAIN.C, Warlord sends his regards.
column2: 先声明，我投票留下并建造厉害防御工事，但HEX说这是实验室，不是战场。反正你来晚了，MAIN.C，军阀向你问好。

column1: I think one of them got wind of what VL-GR0 was up to and wanted something even better. I tried to convince them it was a bad idea and that not just anyone can do what VL-GR0 can, but they didn't take that well and almost shot me then and there.
column2: 我想他们中有人听说VL-GR0在做什么，就想要更好的东西。我劝过他们这主意糟糕，不是谁都能像VL-GR0那样，但他们不听，差点当场开枪打我。

column1: This one said they'd fill my processors with garbage if I didn't build exactly what they want.
column2: 这人说，如果我不完全照他们想的造，就要往我的处理器里塞垃圾。

column1: I haven't gotten around to building the cannon yet, but they said the idea is to have a cannon with 'ridiculously high matter cost' but a correspondingly ridiculous high damage, and the ability to slot in the best high-capacity matter pods they can find for more efficient transfer while firing.
column2: 我还没开始造火炮，但他们的想法是：造一门物质消耗“高得离谱”、伤害也高得离谱的炮，还能装最好的大容量物质舱，提升射击时的供料效率。

column1: I hear [REDACTED] exploded during the installation process. I did warn them to fully install it before trying to fire, and something tells me that's where things went wrong. Still I'm glad they didn't listen, that way I'm not culpable for whatever they would've done with it. If we're lucky even some of the others got blasted, too.
column2: 听说[已删改]在安装时爆炸了。我提醒他们先完整安装再试射；看来就是这一步出了问题。不过幸好他们没听，免得我得为他们用它做的事负责。运气好的话，也有别人被炸飞了。
